About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Product Marketing Manager for Nu Global

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

About the role

Launched in 2026, Nu Global is a global account that people can use to earn, send, and move money worldwide: a daily-yield balance held in digital dollars and digital euros, fee-free transfers to 35+ countries across both regions, a card for spending abroad, and access to curated digital assets. The Product Marketing Manager for Nu Global owns go-to-market to the existing customer base, lifecycle communications (CLM), the Nu Global website experience, the App Store and Google Play listing, and product-led content across channels.

CLM is the heaviest of these work streams and a core part of the role. You will reach customers through email, push notifications, in-app messages and marketing screens, using Nu's proprietary CRM platform, so the quality of this work directly drives adoption and engagement of Nu Global products.

The role is execution-heavy and sits in a small team: a lead PMM, a growth marketer and a partnership activation marketer. You own the delivery and results of your work streams, with direction on priorities from the lead PMM.

You'll be responsible for

Your week is split between running lifecycle programs and keeping the other owned surfaces (website, store listing, content) aligned with what the product is launching. The main challenge is delivering a high volume of work with quality while keeping customer touchpoints prioritized and not overloaded.

  • Lifecycle programs (CLM): build, launch and optimize programs end to end: audience segmentation, journeys and triggers, email, push notifications, in-app messages and marketing screens, including QA, scheduling and frequency control.

  • Lifecycle roadmap: maintain an always-on communications calendar across onboarding, activation, engagement and cross-sell, coordinated with the lead PMM, Growth and Product.

  • Go-to-market to existing customers: plan and execute the communication of launches, new products and feature updates, driving adoption by segment, market and language.

  • Website experience: own page content, messaging updates and conversion improvements for the Nu Global website, in partnership with Design, Product and CX.

  • Store listing: own App Store and Google Play listing copy, creatives and releases, aligned to product launches and positioning.

  • Product-led content: adapt product narratives into channel-specific content (CRM, web, store, social) and keep positioning and tone consistent across surfaces and markets.

  • Experimentation and measurement: run A/B and holdout tests on messaging, timing and channel; define KPIs per program (delivery, open, click, activation, adoption, conversion); report results and turn them into next iterations.

  • Cross-functional alignment: work with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, CX, Business Analytics and local market teams on launch timing, product readiness, and legal and eligibility requirements before activating the customer base.

  • Documentation and governance: maintain playbooks, templates, access and naming conventions for lifecycle programs and other owned surfaces, so operations stay auditable and scalable.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Deep, hands-on experience operating a CRM or marketing automation platform across its full scope (segmentation, journeys, templates, email, push, in-app messaging, experimentation and reporting), able to run it independently from day one.

  • Direct ownership of CLM, CRM or lifecycle marketing programs for a digital product, driving adoption and engagement within an existing customer base.

  • Planned and executed go-to-market and launch communications for products and features.

  • Owned website content and store listing, or equivalent product-led content across channels.

  • A strong execution track record: high ownership, attention to detail, and delivering a high volume of work with quality, taking direction on priorities from a lead.

  • Worked with customer data and experimentation: reads funnel and campaign metrics, structures tests and makes decisions with incomplete data.

  • Aligned Product, Engineering, Compliance, CX and local markets on timing and readiness without escalating by default.

  • Uses behavioral and CX signals to refine audiences, messages and timing.

  • Applies AI and automation to scale content production and CRM operations, evaluating initiatives on ROI, effort and risk.

  • Fluency in Portuguese and Spanish, and professional proficiency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with, or connection to, Latin American and European markets (for example having worked on, lived in or supported them).

  • Experience with CRM analytics (SQL or equivalent) and experimentation frameworks.

  • Experience with website CMS and App Store optimization (ASO).

  • Experience with localization and multi-language content operations.

Location for this opportunity

  • São Paulo, Brazil (preferred)

  • Miami, United States (also possible)

Our Benefits

Brazil:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

US:

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Nubank is creating its first dedicated Insider Threat Defense team, and you will be the leader who builds it from scratch. Sitting within Information Security, this first-line-of-defense team detects and responds to risks coming from inside the company, such as privileged access misuse, sensitive data exfiltration, credential sale and collusion, sabotage, and remote worker and hiring fraud.

Protecting the trust of more than 127 million customers starts with protecting our own access and data. This is a structural, high-visibility role with M-team sponsorship, and you will own the strategy, the roadmap, and the results: detection coverage, speed of detection, and quality of response.

You will hire and lead the squad, define the scenarios that matter most, and work closely with Conduct Risk (2LOD), Legal, People, Risk, and Privacy. The team detects and qualifies; those areas decide on consequences, keeping a clear separation of roles and independent challenge.


You'll be responsible for

  • Building the team: hire, lead, and develop a specialized squad of detection experts, analysts, and engineers, starting with a small team and growing across Brazil and our international locations, in a high-performance, inclusive, and AI-first culture.

  • Defining strategy and roadmap: set the Insider Threat Defense strategy, scenario taxonomy, and priorities, focusing on the highest residual-risk scenarios (e.g., product abuse, data leakage, privileged access misuse, queue manipulation, code of conduct breaches).

  • Creating the foundations: define policies, scope, documentation, and operating model for a capability that doesn't exist yet at Nubank.

  • Owning governance and key interfaces: work with People, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Conduct Risk on sensitive cases, preserving line separation and formal model-risk governance.

  • Operating through shared services: ensure effective handoffs and clear SLAs with GSOC (24/7 triage), CSIRT (response and containment), and Threat Detection.

  • Driving automation and AI: use AI and automation to correlate identity, access, and data movement signals and reduce manual analyst effort, without losing detection quality.

  • Reporting to leadership: give executives, regulators, and Internal Audit enterprise-wide visibility of insider risk, including a monthly governance forum and an annual review.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Led security detection, response, or investigation teams, ideally standing up a new capability in a high-scale environment.

  • Hands-on knowledge of insider threat or internal fraud scenarios in technology or financial companies, including UEBA, privileged access misuse, and data exfiltration patterns.

  • Solid technical grounding in SIEM, SOAR, detection engineering, and incident response, enough to guide technical decisions and challenge the team.

  • Worked with People, Legal, Privacy, and Risk on sensitive topics, with strong judgment and discretion.

  • Hired, coached, and grown senior individual contributors, and managed performance.

  • Translated complex technical risks into clear, actionable messages for executives and regulators.

  • Proficiency in English (understanding and speaking) for global collaboration.


Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated environments, including regulatory expectations on non-financial risk and three-lines-of-defense models.

  • Experience in insider threat programs, internal fraud, or hybrid cyber/physical investigations.

  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS/GCP) and modern data platforms for security analytics.

  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, or CERT Insider Threat guidance.

  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations and time zones.


Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil


Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nubank is scaling rapidly across Latin America, and our Mexico division is central to empowering millions of people with intuitive, transparent, and accessible financial services. To support our sustained customer growth and expand our product ecosystem reliably, we need senior technical leaders who can translate high-level business vision into resilient, scalable distributed architectures.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical anchor across the Mexico division, collaborating closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams spanning Growth, Operations, and Core Value Proposition. You will bridge local market dynamics with Nubank's global platform ecosystem, steering architectural decisions that directly impact how prospects seamlessly transition into engaged Nubank customers.

Operating with a country-wide horizontal perspective, you will guide technical roadmaps across multiple business units and squads, untangle complex domain boundaries, and elevate engineering standards across chapters. By pairing architectural vision with pragmatic delivery, you will ensure our systems remain resilient, extensible, and prepared for exponential scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for the Mexico division using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to decouple complex systems and eliminate single points of failure.

  • Steer technical strategy across squads in Growth, Operations, and Core Value Prop, ensuring local business flows integrate seamlessly with Nubank’s global platform foundation.

  • Mentor and develop senior engineering talent across chapters, cultivating technical excellence, architectural rigor, and operational best practices.

  • Partner with engineering directors and executive leadership to translate commercial objectives into scalable system designs and actionable execution roadmaps.

  • Drive cross-team technical consensus on mission-critical initiatives, advocating for sound trade-offs between delivery velocity and platform extensibility.

  • Champion operational resilience and observability across customer acquisition funnels, proactively identifying bottlenecks to optimize conversion latency and system reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of technical leadership as a Staff-level engineer (or equivalent scope) guiding distributed systems architecture across multi-team engineering organizations.

  • Deep practical expertise applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to design, decouple, and scale event-driven microservices.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional technical roadmaps across globally distributed platform and product teams without direct hierarchical authority.

  • Experience architecting mission-critical, high-throughput systems where fault tolerance, reliability, and low-latency performance are essential.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, with demonstrated success communicating complex architectural concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish or prior engineering experience building digital products tailored for the Latin American market (specifically Mexico).

  • Background designing high-conversion growth, onboarding, or acquisition engines within large-scale consumer technology or high-growth fintech environments.

  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud-native ecosystems, functional programming paradigms (e.g., Clojure, Scala), or distributed event streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

  • Track record of building and scaling systems at top-tier global technology companies.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in Mexico City on a Hybrid model.

Work model: Hybrid,3 times per week.

Willingness and ability to travel to our Mexico City office approximately once per quarter for cross-team planning and collaboration.

Diversity & Inclusion / Equal Opportunity

At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For information on how we process your personal data throughout the recruitment process, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice on our careers page.

Operating with a country-wide horizontal perspective, you will guide technical roadmaps across multiple business units and squads, untangle complex domain boundaries, and elevate engineering standards across chapters. By pairing architectural vision with pragmatic delivery, you will ensure our systems remain resilient, extensible, and prepared for exponential scale. RESPONSIBILITIES - Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for the Mexico division using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to decouple complex systems and eliminate single points of failure. - Steer technical strategy across squads in Growth, Operations, and Core Value Prop, ensuring local business flows integrate seamlessly with Nubank’s global platform foundation. - Mentor and develop senior engineering talent across chapters, cultivating technical excellence, architectural rigor, and operational best practices. - Partner with engineering directors and executive leadership to translate commercial objectives into scalable system designs and actionable execution roadmaps. - Drive cross-team technical consensus on mission-critical initiatives, advocating for sound trade-offs between delivery velocity and platform extensibility. - Champion operational resilience and observability across customer acquisition funnels, proactively identifying bottlenecks to optimize conversion latency and system reliability. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Demonstrated track record of technical leadership as a Staff-level engineer (or equivalent scope) guiding distributed systems architecture across multi-team engineering organizations. - Deep practical expertise applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to design, decouple, and scale event-driven microservices. - Proven ability to influence cross-functional technical roadmaps across globally distributed platform and product teams without direct hierarchical authority. - Experience architecting mission-critical, high-throughput systems where fault tolerance, reliability, and low-latency performance are essential. - Professional working proficiency in English, with demonstrated success communicating complex architectural concepts to both technical and executive audiences. NICE TO HAVE - Professional working proficiency in Spanish or prior engineering experience building digital products tailored for the Latin American market (specifically Mexico). - Background designing high-conversion growth, onboarding, or acquisition engines within large-scale consumer technology or high-growth fintech environments. - Hands-on experience with modern cloud-native ecosystems, functional programming paradigms (e.g., Clojure, Scala), or distributed event streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka). - Track record of building and scaling systems at top-tier global technology companies. LOCATION & WORK MODEL This role is based in Mexico City on a Hybrid model. Work model: Hybrid,3 times per week. Willingness and ability to travel to our Mexico City office approximately once per quarter for cross-team planning and collaboration. About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Team

The Global Risk function at Nu is structured around two dimensions: country risk officers (horizontal) and global functional heads by risk discipline (vertical). This matrix creates a "risk surface" that allows the organization to scale efficiently without duplicating senior expertise across geographies.

The Head of Risk US will lead the US risk surface, owning all risk disciplines locally while maintaining close coordination with global functional heads: Global Credit Risk, the Global Market and Liquidity Head, and other risk domain leads.

The US risk team is in its early stages, with existing members covering Compliance, Financial Crime/AML, Regulatory, and is expected to grow in line with the business. This is a build-from-scratch opportunity for a senior executive who thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments.

About the Role

The Head of Risk US is a senior executive responsible for the effective and independent oversight of all risk disciplines within Nu's US operation.

The role requires a leader who understands the US regulatory landscape deeply, can engage independently with regulators and senior governance bodies, and is capable of building a high-performing risk function in a fast-moving fintech environment.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact position that will interact frequently with the US Board/Risk Committee, senior regulators, and Nu's executive leadership team.

Key Responsibilities and Expectations

Risk Framework & Governance

  • Build and lead a comprehensive risk management framework for the US operation, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance risk.

  • Develop a risk appetite framework and limit structure aligned with the US Board's stated risk tolerance, ensuring all business lines operate within defined parameters.

  • Establish robust risk metrics, reporting dashboards, and early warning indicators to monitor exposures and escalate material issues in a timely manner.

  • Serve as Secretary to the US Board Risk Management Committee; prepare and circulate agendas and minutes.

  • Participate as a permanent member of key senior management committees including the Risk Committee, ALCO, Compliance Committee, and New Product Approval Committee.

Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary independent risk voice in all interactions with US regulators, engaging with confidence and autonomy.

  • Ensure Nu's control environment consistently meets and anticipates regulatory expectations in a rapidly evolving US regulatory landscape.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with regulators, demonstrating transparency, preparedness, and a mature risk culture.

Risk Surface Management

  • Oversee the day-to-day management of the US risk surface, coordinating with global functional heads on credit, market/liquidity, operational, and financial crime risk.

  • Apply Nu's "target friction" philosophy: prioritize controls based on materiality, avoiding uniform friction in favor of risk-proportionate management that enables business growth.

  • Monitor operational loss events, cyber incidents, and key risk indicators, ensuring mitigation strategies are in place and effective.

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead and develop the US risk team, fostering a culture of high standards, intellectual rigor, and ownership.

  • Build a strong working relationship with engineering and technology teams to ensure risk infrastructure is prioritized and developed appropriately.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the US Country Manager, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to embed risk awareness across the organization.

  • Act as a business partner to the US leadership team — risk as an enabler, not a blocker.

Qualifications

Professional Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc Finance, JD) or professional certification (CFA, FRM) preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, with a significant portion of that in the US market.

  • Deep expertise in the US regulatory environment (OCC, Fed, FDIC); experience engaging directly with regulators at a senior level is essential.

  • Background in financial institutions, fintechs, or challenger banks strongly preferred. Candidates with exclusive experience at large traditional banks (without demonstrated adaptability) may not be the right fit for this stage of growth.

  • Experience building or significantly transforming a risk function from an early/mid-stage into a mature framework.

  • Solid understanding of all risk disciplines: credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance — with particular depth in the control environment (AML/BSA, operational risk, cyber).

  • Credit risk expertise is valued but not the primary focus; Nu's global credit function provides strong support in this area.

Competencies & Attributes

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a proven ability to build structure from scratch in fast-moving environments — "generating balance based on chaos."

  • Hands-on leader who is present on the ground and willing to be deeply involved in operational realities, not just strategic oversight.

  • Independent thought leader capable of engaging directly with boards and regulators without relying on hierarchical support for every interaction.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with engineering/technology teams — able to translate risk requirements into development priorities and negotiate trade-offs effectively.

  • Risk philosophy aligned with Nu's approach: sees friction as a tool to be applied proportionally to materiality, not a default stance. Views risk as a business partner.

  • Highly adaptive: able to respond quickly to changes in the regulatory landscape and reprioritize accordingly.

  • Intellectually curious, data-driven, and committed to continuous learning.

Work Setup

Location

Miami, US
Washington, US

Work model

Expected: Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide

  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences

  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services

  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary

  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users

  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD

  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Advanced English skills

Compensation & benefits


For candidates based in Canada, the annual base salary range for this position is CA$168,000–CA$210,000. Where you land within the range depends on factors such as your skills, qualifications, and experience.

At Nubank, we look at compensation as a whole: base salary, equity in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs), and benefits. Equity is an important part of the package and gives you a way to share in Nubank’s long-term success. We’re happy to walk you through how the pieces fit together and talk about what matters most to you as you evaluate the opportunity.

We also offer benefits to support different parts of life and work:

Health & well-being: health and life insurance, plus NuCare, our mental health and wellness assistance program.

Financial security & family: a pension plan, extended maternity and paternity leaves, and vacation.

Learning & growth: Nucleo, our learning platform with courses, and NuLanguage, our language learning program.

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

Once here, you will:

  • Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

  • Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

  • Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

  • Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

  • Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

  • Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

  • Experience in digital products;

  • Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

  • Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 20 days time off and 14 company holidays. 

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid (3 days in-office per week): Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Engineering at Nubank

At Nubank, software engineers sit at the intersection of data, intelligence, and scale. We build systems that process millions of decisions daily, from fraud detection to credit modeling and increasingly, we do this powered by AI. Machine learning is embedded across our core products: in how we assess risk, personalize experiences, and automate decisions at scale. Engineers here don't just consume AI capabilities; they help shape how intelligence is built, deployed, and maintained in production.

We do it with engineering rigor, autonomy, and a deep focus on impact. Our engineers work across the full spectrum: designing data pipelines and architectures, deploying and maintaining ML models in production, and building the distributed systems and platforms that power our products. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices across our entire stack. While we value candidates familiar with our technologies, we're confident that engineers who join Nubank will learn and grow alongside our team:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, leveraging functional programming and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput event-driven architectures for inter-service communication

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into cloud-native infrastructure

  • Distributed transactional systems built on Datomic, modeling complex business domains with immutable data and strong consistency

  • Modern data platforms built on ETL/ELT best practices, with robust monitoring and observability

Our Software Engineers

  • Work with large scale distributed systems

  • Collaborate with building microservices

  • Design, build and maintain robust data pipelines, distributed systems and ML-enabled solutions, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance at scale

  • Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Lead data and engineering projects end-to-end — from requirements gathering and stakeholder alignment to delivery and iteration

  • Contribute to the design, documentation, maintenance and optimization of our data codebase, platforms and tooling

  • Translate business needs into data products and technical solutions aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term strategy

  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to define strategies and deliver high-impact solutions

  • Share knowledge, mentor peers and contribute to engineering and data literacy initiatives across Nubank

What We're Looking For

  • Programming experience in one or more general-purpose languages (e.g. Python, Clojure, Scala, Java)

  • Familiarity with analytical data environments and data engineering concepts: pipelines, ETL/ELT, and data modeling

  • Understanding of ML model lifecycle, from training and evaluation to deployment and monitoring

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices and asynchronous architectures

  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Passion for building high-quality software and data products

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart)

  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and feature engineering pipelines

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar)

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices: testing, clean code, documentation

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance, Medical Plan and Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform

  • Extended Parental Leave, Daycare Allowance and Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.

For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in leading the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems within your team, and influencing technical decisions in close collaboration with adjacent teams. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

You will build and evolve:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS

  • Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.

You'll be responsible for

  • Working with large-scale distributed systems and understanding their broad architecture and trade-offs

  • Leading technical direction for your team and partnering with adjacent teams to keep solutions aligned with our architecture and business strategy

  • Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Mentoring engineers within and around your team and helping maintain a high technical bar

  • Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

  • Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your team

  • Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

  • Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across your team’s services

  • Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

  • Focusing primarily on backend applications

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 6 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

  • A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

  • A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives end-to-end within a team and in collaboration with partner teams

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar in their teams

  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

  • Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks, and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience with data-intensive systems (pipelines, transactional vs. analytical design) is a plus.

  • Advanced English skills

Location

Mexico City, Mexico.

 

Our Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life outside of work. For Mexico, they include:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus (“Aguinaldo”) of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python, Databricks and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 What are we looking for?

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Core Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 17 workdays with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Mexico City, MX

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 What are we looking for?

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

Engenharia no Nubank

Soluções simples de se usar são complexas de serem construídas. No Nubank, buscamos práticas de desenvolvimento de software que permitam com que nossos produtos simplifiquem a vida dos nossos clientes. Isso significa que no ambiente de trabalho se preze por utilizar uma variedade de tecnologias, ferramentas e metodologias de trabalho que venham a atingir esses objetivos.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte do nosso time e não trabalha com as tecnologias que utilizamos aqui, não se preocupe! Temos uma trilha de aprendizado interna para oferecer suporte nessa jornada conosco! Confira um pouco mais do que utilizamos aqui:

  • Microsserviços escaláveis escritos em Clojure

  • Comunicação entre serviços com Kafka

  • Integração e deploy contínuo com AWS

  • Armazenamento de dados com Datomic e DynamoDB

  • Monitoramento e observabilidade com Prometheus

  • Manutenção de uma infraestrutura com alta-disponibilidade em Kubernetes

  • Moldar a experiência dos clientes interagindo com o app usando Flutter

 

Responsabilidades

  • Trabalhar com sistemas de larga escala e distribuídos

  • Colaborar na construção de microsserviços

  • Praticar conhecimentos em metodologias ágeis

  • Trabalhar com entrega contínua e infraestrutura como código

 

Estamos buscando profissionais que

  • Sejam pessoas com deficiência (PcD);

  • Conhecimento prático em linguagens de programação para backend;

  • Prática em frameworks utilizados no desenvolvimento de backend;

  • Possuam habilidade de escrever um código de fácil entendimento e manutenção;

  • Que já tenha vivenciado ou estudado sobre práticas ágeis;

  • O Inglês é um  diferencial. É importante que você esteja confortável em participar de ambientes com comunicação em inglês, e que tenha interesse em desenvolvê-lo, uma vez que o Nubank é uma empresa global. Oferecemos um programa de idiomas interno, o NuLanguage;

  • Disponibilidade para jornada de trabalho em tempo integral;

Benefícios

  • Chance de ganhar capital no Nubank;

  • Cartão Alimentação/Refeição (Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação)

  • Benefício de deslocamento (Vale Transporte)

  • NuCare – Programa de Assistência Psicológica, Financeira e Jurídica

  • Seguro de vida

  • Plano Médico

  • Plano Odontológico

  • NuLanguage – Programa de Curso de Idiomas

  • Nucleo - Nossa plataforma de aprendizagem de cursos

  • Licença parental estendida

  • Auxílio-creche

  • Subsídio para trabalhar em casa

  • Parcerias com academias

  • 30 dias de férias remuneradas

  • Pacote de Auxílio Relocação, quando aplicável.

 

Modelo de trabalho para esta posição

Híbrido (2 a 3 vezes por semana)
Nosso modelo híbrido prevê a ida ao escritório pelo menos duas vezes por semana, em dias estratégicos definidos para maximizar a conexão e a colaboração entre os times. Para mais detalhes, visite https://building.nubank.com/pt-br/nu-trabalho-hibrido-modelo/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

  • Plan and execute on entire features, collaborating with peers while planning the work ahead

  • Collaborate in building microservices and work with continuous delivery and infrastructure as code

  • Work with agile software development methodologies

  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code

  • Pair, and participate in code reviews, to grow and contribute to the growth of others in and around the team

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and partner Engineering teams to build new experiences

  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary

  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 6 years of experience developing digital products

  • Ability to quickly understand technical and business requirements, translating them into technical design and implementation

  • A problem-solver who is able to communicate effectively across functional teams

  • A software engineer who cares deeply about user experience

  • Proven understanding of object-oriented or functional programming language

  • Notions of distributed systems and familiarity with cloud technologies

  • Have practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD

  • Advanced English skills 

Compensation & benefits


For candidates based in Canada, the annual base salary range for this position is CA$147,996–CA$185,004. Where you land within the range depends on factors such as your skills, qualifications, and experience.

At Nubank, we look at compensation as a whole: base salary, equity in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs), and benefits. Equity is an important part of the package and gives you a way to share in Nubank’s long-term success. We’re happy to walk you through how the pieces fit together and talk about what matters most to you as you evaluate the opportunity.

We also offer benefits to support different parts of life and work:

Health & well-being: health and life insurance, plus NuCare, our mental health and wellness assistance program.

Financial security & family: a pension plan, extended maternity and paternity leaves, and vacation.

Learning & growth: Nucleo, our learning platform with courses, and NuLanguage, our language learning program.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the Role

As a Principal Product Designer, you are the senior-most design authority on the team. You are a visionary with the ability to execute swiftly, articulating solutions that don't just improve the status quo but redefine it. This is an IC9-level role, meaning you operate with exceptional autonomy to drive strategic change across multiple countries and functions.

You will be the guardian of our "purple" identity, responsible for defining 0-1 experiences and elevating the level of craftsmanship across our entire global product. From leading the next generation of our illustration system to architecting the core interaction patterns of our homepage, your work will set the technical and aesthetic foundations that millions of people interact with daily. You are a consultant to leadership, a mentor to the guild, and a pioneer of design excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Define the Vision: Lead the creation of 0-1 product experiences, setting a high bar for concept and quality that inspires the entire design organization.

  • Evolve the Visual Identity: Spearhead the global transition to our new illustration system. Define scalable guidelines that move us from current standards to a unified, global language.

  • Architect Core Interactions: Define the structural patterns and widgets for the Nu homepage. Deliver production-ready specifications that bridge the gap between high-level design and engineering execution.

  • Unify Global Design: Eliminate fragmentation across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. You will create a cohesive design language that feels like "one Nu" while intelligently allowing for local market flexibility.

  • Drive Strategic Roadmap: Act as an advisor to business leadership, translating organizational strategy into a tangible design roadmap and removing blocks to ensure a world-class user experience.

  • Mentor and Influence: Act as an ambassador for design craft. You will coach senior design leaders and foster a culture of open communication, empathy, and continuous improvement.

  • Master AI & Innovation: Identify breakthrough opportunities to integrate AI into the design workflow and product experience, ensuring ethical standards and user trust are always prioritized.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Deep Design Mastery: Extensive experience leading design at a global scale, with a portfolio that demonstrates world-class visual craft, UI excellence, and systems thinking.

  • Proven Strategic Leadership: Ability to drive large-scale organizational transformations and influence enterprise-level strategy through design.

  • Architectural Thinking: Deep expertise in design systems, interaction patterns, and creating scalable frameworks for complex digital products.

  • Swift Execution: A "visionary who does"—the ability to quickly prototype and articulate high-fidelity solutions that solve complex, ambiguous business problems.

  • Exceptional Communication: Mastery in communicating complex design logic to executive stakeholders and mentoring other designers to improve their persuasive storytelling.

  • Global Perspective: Experience working across diverse markets and cultures, with the ability to balance global consistency and local relevance.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in pioneering AI-driven design tools or features.

Our Benefits

  • A high leverage compensation package benchmarked against global tech leaders, combining a competitive base salary ($312,000) with significant equity (RSUs) to ensure your success is directly tied to the long-term growth of the purple future we are building together.

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) matching

  • 20 days time off, 14 company holidays, and great culture that emphasizes work life balance. 

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Twice a week in the office (Palo Alto) + quarterly trips to Sao Paulo (Brazil) to build relationships with coworkers. 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the Role

You’ll be part of Nu’s global expansion one of the most exciting chapters in our story. As we enter new international markets, customer experience is our most powerful differentiator, and this role sits at the heart of it.

As a Customer Experience Analyst on our internationalization team, you’ll be a founding member of a CX operation built from scratch in a brand-new country. That means you’ll do more than handle customer interactions — you’ll help shape how we operate, train, and grow across borders. From delivering mind-blowingly great support to identifying process gaps and turning customer feedback into business insight, your work will directly influence what Nu looks like for customers in new markets around the world.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about people, and is excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up — with the full backing of a global platform behind them.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Deliver first and second level customer support across chat, email, back-office, and phone channels, consistently meeting CX metrics and ensuring an outstanding customer experience in all supported languages.

  • Manage the CX knowledge base and training processes to ensure team members are equipped to handle all case types — including complex and escalation-worthy situations — with confidence.

  • Monitor CX metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and design and implement action plans to continuously improve performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Alert relevant stakeholders to operational needs and opportunities, including headcount requirements, training gaps, and people-related inputs.

  • Coordinate local initiatives with broader organizational and cross-functional efforts involving the Xpeer team, including support for new international market launches.

  • Ensure all customer excellence processes are documented, accessible, and kept up to date at the squad level.

  • Switch seamlessly across support squads and roles as the team grows and evolves, bringing consistency and energy to each area.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in customer service or operations roles, ideally in high-volume or fast-paced environments.

  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish plus at least one of the following languages: English, Portuguese, German, Italian or French— written and spoken. Language skills will be evaluated during the hiring process.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to read metrics, spot patterns, and turn insights into action.

  • Excellent people skills: you genuinely enjoy engaging with customers and colleagues from diverse backgrounds, and you go the extra mile to create memorable experiences.

  • Comfort working across multiple tools, topics, and roles simultaneously — multitasking comes naturally to you.

  • Studying for or holding a professional degree in any field.

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in more than one additional language from the list above.

  • Experience with knowledge base management or training coordination.

  • Familiarity with CX platforms, ticketing tools, or support metrics dashboards.

Location for this Opportunity

Bogotá, Colombia.

This is a fully on-site role based at our Bogotá office.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage — Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable
