About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As a Lead Business Control Officer (BCO) for the Global Credit Card business, you will play a critical role in strengthening Nu’s first line of defense and enabling sustainable growth of our credit card portfolio globally. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Global Credit Card, Product, Operations, and Risk to proactively identify, assess, and manage non-financial risks, ensuring that business objectives are achieved with a strong and efficient control environment.

You will be a hands-on leader, setting the bar for risk excellence while enabling innovation. You will help establish and continuously evolve the BCO model for Global Credit Card, embedding risk ownership in the first line, challenging how we work today, and helping us build best-in-class risk management practices.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Acting as the primary first-line risk partner for the Global Credit Card business, balancing risk management with business objectives and customer impact.

  • Driving a thorough understanding of end-to-end processes, risks, and controls across the Global Credit Card lifecycle, from product design and onboarding to servicing, collections, and support.

  • Designing, assessing, and continuously improving internal controls to ensure risks are identified, mitigated, and monitored effectively.

  • Leading and coordinating first-line risk management activities, including risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), loss and risk event management, issue remediation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Ensuring strong governance, risk, and compliance practices in alignment with internal policies, global frameworks, and applicable external regulations.

  • Supporting product and feature development by bringing a proactive risk lens to strategic decisions, business cases, and go-to-market plans.

  • Defining, tracking, and reporting meaningful risk and control metrics (KPIs/KRIs) that enable effective monitoring of the control environment and timely decision-making.

  • Building and running pragmatic, non-bureaucratic governance forums that bring together key stakeholders to discuss risks, controls, incidents, and remediation plans.

  • Preparing and presenting clear, concise risk reports and updates to senior leadership and relevant governance bodies.

  • Partnering with second and third lines of defense to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective challenge, while maintaining strong ownership of risks in the first line.

  • Contributing to the ongoing evolution of the BCO framework at Nu, sharing best practices, proposing improvements, and helping shape how we operate as a global first-line risk team.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Proven experience working with credit card products and businesses, preferably in a global or multi-market environment.

  • Solid experience in non-financial risk management, operational risk, or related risk disciplines within financial services or fintech.

  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, governance, and regulatory expectations for consumer credit products.

  • Experience designing, assessing, and improving processes and internal controls, including documentation and process mapping.

  • Proven ability to influence and build strong relationships with stakeholders at different levels of the organization, including senior leaders.

  • A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to dive deep into details while keeping a strategic view of risks and priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey risk topics in a clear, concise, and structured way.

  • Independence, proactivity, and a strong desire to challenge the status quo and improve how we work.

Nice to have

  • Experience in first-line risk roles directly embedded in business or product teams.

  • Prior exposure to SOX or similar internal control over financial reporting frameworks.

  • Experience working with teams across different countries and cultures.

  • Knowledge of data, analytics, or tooling that can help automate and enhance risk and control monitoring.


Location for this opportunity

Virgínia (DC Metro)



Our Benefits (United States)

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu.

  • Medical Insurance.

  • Dental and Vision Insurance.

  • Life Insurance and AD&D.

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves.

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses.

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program.

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program.

  • 401K.

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account.

  • Work-from-home Allowance.

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times | week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

We offer relocation package for those who are available to be relocated to the DC region.

Explore how we build products, technology, and experiences at Nu:

  • https://building.nubank.com.br

  • https://youtube.com/@building.nubank

  • https://open.spotify.com/show/4hAJnAkYKXl42hLXa4LmVQ

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at the Senior Staff level to serve as a horizontal technology leader across our Core Infrastructure and Platform teams. At Nu, a TPM is an Outcome Owner—an engineer at heart with the programmatic capability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from inception to production. You are fully accountable for the efficiency, scaling, and modernization of our foundational platforms.

Your mission is to lead horizontal infrastructure transformations at a massive scale. You will optimize database and network utilization, steer regionalization strategies, and guide our architectural evolution—whether that means refactoring monoliths into microservices or right-sizing macro-services. Crucially, you will be at the forefront of integrating AI into our core foundational platforms and ML infrastructure to maximize engineering leverage.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own Infrastructure Evolution: Lead programmatic execution for large-scale architectural shifts, including microservices refactoring, service optimization, and complex regionalization strategies.

  • Maximize Efficiency & Scale: Drive initiatives to drastically increase hardware, database, and network utilization across our global infrastructure footprint.

  • Steer AI/ML Platform Transformations: Own the program roadmap for embedding cutting-edge AI capabilities and advanced ML infrastructure directly into our foundational core platforms.

  • Collaborate Horizontally: Roll up your sleeves to map out and manage deep technical dependencies across disparate infrastructure, data engineering, and platform squads.

  • Define North-Star Architecture: Partner with senior engineering stakeholders to determine what our destination, long-term technical architecture looks like, converting that vision into actionable engineering phases.

Core Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

  • The "Engineer‑First" Background: A proven foundational background as an Infrastructure, Site Reliability (SRE), or Core Backend Engineer earlier in your career before moving into technical program leadership. Please note: This is not a project coordinator role. We require deep technical expertise in these areas to effectively guide the engineering organization.

  • Hands-on Technical Leadership: A strong track record of driving initiatives not just through tracking, but through active technical contribution. You possess the hands-on technical leadership and ability to unblock teams using your own technical expertise when complex engineering bottlenecks arise.

  • Ownership & Entrepreneurial Mindset: A distinct ownership mentality with an entrepreneurial, "raise the bar" attitude. You don't just manage a roadmap; you treat the infrastructure as your own product, constantly pushing for higher standards of engineering excellence, efficiency, and scale.

  • High-Scale Infrastructure Depth: Extensive experience managing massive cloud-native systems, focusing heavily on core networking, distributed databases, and high-utilization environments.

  • AI Transformation Experience: A highly valued track record of leading or heavily contributing to AI/ML transformation initiatives at scale.

  • Architectural Mastery: Proven ability to navigate complex architectural patterns (monoliths, microservices, nano-services) and successfully execute horizontal multi-year infrastructure roadmaps.

  • Execution Mindset: Strong business acumen, executive communication skills, and a natural ability to step in and aggressively unblock engineering teams in an agile, fast-moving environment.

Our Benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) matching

  • 20 days time off, 14 company holidays, and great culture that emphasizes work life balance.

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Twice a week in the office + quarterly trips to Sao Paulo (Brazil) to build relationships with coworkers.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the Role

The TA Ops team powers Nubank’s recruiting operation: systems, data, efficiency, risk, partnerships, and enablement. In the Systems Management pillar, you will be the hands-on admin of the recruiting stack, with Ashby as the ATS and tools such as CodeSignal, helping systems and processes work together at scale.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Administer Ashby and its connected tools day to day: configuration, permissions, user and role management, workflows, templates, and custom fields.

  • Handle and resolve requests from recruiters, coordinators, and TA leadership, learning to act autonomously on recurring cases.

  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and escalate to vendors or engineering when needed.

  • Support systems and integration projects, from requirements gathering through testing and rollout.

  • Keep documentation up to date and follow the team’s intake, prioritization, and change management practices.

  • Query data with SQL, build reports, and write simple scripts and automations.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end recruiting workflow (requisition, sourcing, interviewing, scheduling, offer, hiring) and how an ATS supports it.

  • Hands-on experience with a large, robust ATS such as Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, or similar, ideally as an admin, power user, or recruiting operations/coordination professional.

  • Comfort reading API and product documentation, and curiosity to learn how systems connect.

  • Attention to detail and a commitment to keeping data clean and reliable.

  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English for working with vendors and global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with Ashby.

  • Exposure to integrations between ATS, HRIS, assessment, and scheduling tools.

  • Familiarity with ITSM practices (ticketing, SLAs, change management).

  • Entry-level technical skills: basic SQL to query and validate data, and basic coding (Python, Apps Script, or similar) to automate simple tasks.

Location

São Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Our mission is to evolve the platform architecture and workflows that let Insurance scale across more customers, more products, and new markets, and to close the gap between AI capabilities built centrally and their reliable adoption in production.

As a Staff Software Engineer - Insurance, you will be a senior technical leader across two connected fronts: diagnosing and evolving our service architecture as the platform scales, and leading the rollout of AI/agentic tooling across the team's engineering workflow, from spec and code generation to testing and validation.

You will operate at platform scale, building infrastructure and practices other teams depend on, while partnering closely with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Insurance partners. You'll be part of a lean, entrepreneurial team that delivers outsized business impact while protecting millions of customers, sitting at the intersection of embedded insurance, Nu's most important customer surfaces, and our insurer partners. This team is also one of the earliest adopters of agentic engineering within Nubank, putting you at the center of how that transformation actually happens.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Diagnosing and evolving our platform architecture to remove constraints on scale, supporting a growing user base, expanding product portfolio, and global expansion.

  • Providing AI-first engineering leadership, setting the standards and practices for how the team builds and evolves with AI/agentic tooling.

  • Cutting through ambiguity, surfacing trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Security, Compliance, Insurance partners) around clear outcomes.

  • Ensuring observability for AI systems and platform services in production (tracing, logging, alerting).

  • Mentoring engineers on technical approach across both architecture and AI/agentic best practices, raising the team's execution level over time.

  • Evaluating and incorporating both internal (Nubank) and external AI tools and agents into our workflows, based on what best fits our needs.

  • Partnering with Nubank's central AI/platform teams and other BUs to share learnings and stay aligned on tooling direction.

  • Enabling more Nubankers to safely contribute to AI-powered products over time (engineers and non-engineers)

  • Embedding responsible, auditable practices in everything shipped, across platform and AI systems alike, per applicable regulations and internal risk standards.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Proven technical leadership as a senior/staff engineer delivering high-impact, large-scale software systems in production.

  • Track record of mentoring and uplifting peers on technical approach and AI-native workflows.

  • Strong systems/platform engineering experience: architecture, CI/CD, test automation, able to evolve infrastructure to support reliable adoption of new technology.

  • Genuine interest and foundational knowledge of AI/LLM concepts, ready to build hands-on fluency with our agentic tooling.

  • Ownership mindset for rolling out AI/agentic tooling across a team, driving adoption of testing, CI/CD validation, and evaluation practices, not just personal use.

  • Strong full-stack thinking: ability to design maintainable codebases and APIs that bridge model inference/orchestration layers with user-facing surfaces.

  • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional projects that require coordination across multiple business units and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated strategic acumen, linking technical initiatives to business drivers such as operational efficiency, risk, and customer acquisition or engagement.

  • Experience in fintech or other regulated industries (e.g., financial services, insurance, payments) or similarly complex domains.

  • Advanced English for daily collaboration in a global environment.

Nice to Have

  • AI-first mindset with professional experience implementing LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and/or RAG systems in real-world products.

  • Solid understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, context management, and agent loops, with ability to contribute to shared agent libraries and commands.

  • Experience building or contributing to automated test/CI-CD evaluation frameworks that catch and fix failures with minimal human intervention.

  • Background in insurance or embedded insurance products.

  • Experience scaling products across international markets and languages.

  • Familiarity with Portuguese and/or Spanish to read or review customer-facing copy (optional).

  • Prior experience in AI-first startups or big-tech environments with strong AI/ML teams.

Location for this opportunity

  • São Paulo, Buenos Aires

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our Benefits

For this role, we offer a competitive, global-level package that currently includes:

 

  • Competitive compensation and company equity

  • Bi-annual trips to Brazil to build relationships with coworkers

  • Top-tier Medical Insurance

  • Top-tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Generous time off and company holidays

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

Specific benefits may vary slightly by country and will be detailed during the process.

Join us

If you want to help evolve the architecture and AI-powered workflows that let Nubank’s Insurance platform scale across products and markets — combining deep systems thinking with hands-on agentic engineering — we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to be our Staff Software Engineer – Insurance.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Audit Senior Specialist

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.

This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

You'll be responsible for

  • Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

  • Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks.

  • Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.

  • Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks.

  • Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks.

  • Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting.

  • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

  • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

  • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

  • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

We are looking for a person who has

Experience and background

  • A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience.

  • Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework.

  • Meaningful experience in fintech or banking.

  • Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees.

  • Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure.

Ways of working and skills

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • A genuinely hands-on posture

  • A builder mindset

  • A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential.

Cultural openness and humility

  • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives.

  • Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense.

  • German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Our Compliance Chapter

The Compliance Team has a very special role in our mission: support the company’s growth by identifying the regulatory risks that NU faces; designing and implementing controls to protect Nu from such risks; and by providing advisory to the Business on regulations and internal policies to create the best product or service that follows with these external and internal regulations and standards.

Responsibilities assigned to you might be related to:

  • Research regulations and project management for its implementation.

  • Project management related to new regulations and licensing processes.

  • Lead efforts and align requirements towards new financial licenses.

  • Evaluate from a compliance perspective new products and features to be launched.

  • Keep other teams abreast of requirements by researching regulatory and filing information; writing and communicating guidelines.

  • Provide advisory to other teams about the regulation to establish new processes or controls.

  • Monitor and respond to inquiries received from Regulators, Auto Regulatory bodies or Auditors.

  • Create and update Compliance policies and procedures.

  • Liaise and work closely with various teams to enhance systems and processes related to Compliance.

  • Coordinate or support regulatory reviews or audits.

  • Support in identifying regulatory gaps and tracking its implementation.

We believe in

  • Entrepreneurship spirit;

  • Exceptional team chemistry;

  • Ownership

How We Work

  • You act like you own the company where you work

  • You are enthusiastic about building partnership with other teams

  • You are willing to go the extra mile and getting involved in many areas

  • You challenge the status quo

  • You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced, results-oriented teams

  • You are hungry and enjoy being constantly challenged to learn and do more

Requirements

  • +7 years' or above experience in regulatory compliance, AML or regulatory areas for Banks, SOFIPO and/or Fintechs.

  • Proven experience in filing and obtention of financial licenses such as Fintech or Bank and project management for that.

  • Experience with CNBV & Banxico regulatory requirements for Financial Institutions.

  • Ability to develop policies and procedures from scratch and implement them.

  • Ability to conduct regulatory advisory and law interpretation by providing consultation to business areas as well as internal clients.

  • Ability to tackle complex problems involving several topics/variables, such as business, regulatory, finance and product.

  • Ability to work and lead through influence multidisciplinary teams (product, software engineering, data science, analysts and customer service).

  • Self-starter and ability to work independently.

  • Great team player, communication (written and verbal) and listening skills.

  • Fluency in both English and Spanish.

The position is based in Mexico City, Mexico

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

MEXICO JOBS:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food Card

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As a Mobile Security Manager, you will lead the Mobile Security team, a group of engineers within Nubank’s Information Security organization. The team’s mission is to keep Nubank’s mobile applications secure and protect the customers who rely on them every day.

Customers use our Android and iOS applications daily, so security risks in them affect customers directly. The team works with engineers and other partners across the company to identify and address those risks throughout the application development lifecycle, from secure design and development to stronger protections in the applications customers use.

You will own the team’s priorities and the solutions it delivers, balancing security, reliability and customer experience. You will also support the development of the engineers on your team and help align priorities as Nubank grows across different countries.

You'll be responsible for

  • Leading, developing and managing the performance of a team of mobile security engineers, including giving feedback and supporting career growth.

  • Setting the team’s priorities and helping it deliver solutions that balance security, reliability and customer experience.

  • Working with teams across Information Security, engineering and other areas to understand risks and align priorities.

  • Supporting secure design and development in Nubank’s Android and iOS applications.

  • Improving the protections in the mobile applications used by our customers.

  • Taking part in technical discussions and supporting engineering decisions.

  • Supporting Nubank’s growth across different countries.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Experience managing and developing engineering teams, including providing feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance.

  • Strong background in software engineering, with the ability to engage in technical discussions and support engineering decisions.

  • Basic knowledge of security concepts and an interest in developing deeper expertise in security.

  • Experience defining priorities, coordinating delivery and balancing technical and business needs.

  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders across different teams and areas.

  • Strong communication skills and proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Android and/or iOS development or mobile security. Previous mobile experience is welcome, but not required.

  • Experience with mobile application protections, such as RASP, security signals, obfuscation or anti-tampering controls.

  • Experience with security engineering, risk assessments or incident response.

  • Experience working with Fraud teams, malware analysis or fraud prevention.

  • Experience with mobile application security testing, including penetration testing or reverse engineering.

  • Experience working in financial services or other environments where security, reliability and customer experience are critical.

Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare: Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage: Language Course Program

  • Nucleo: our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Community-Led Growth Senior Specialist (Emerging Markets)

About the role

As the Community-Led Growth Senior Specialist, you'll build acquisition inside communities Nu doesn't own — WhatsApp and Telegram groups, Reddit threads, diaspora forums — where access is earned, not bought, and where most channels have no native attribution. Once inside these spaces, you'll turn community and cultural insight into content, channel activation, and outreach that drives acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and referral — always through organic, test-and-learn methods.

You will work as the marketing counterpart to a Growth Product Manager. You own community strategy, native content, and channel activation, particularly in social and other hard-to-track spaces where the audience already lives.

This role also works closely with Business Analytics. Because most of the channels you'll operate in have incomplete or no native attribution, contributing to credible proxy measurement — in close partnership with your Growth PM and Business Analytics — is as core to this job as the content and community work itself.

You'll be responsible for

  • Build and scale community-led growth channels: find, seed, and grow presence inside WhatsApp/Telegram groups, Facebook groups, Reddit threads, and diaspora forums where the audience already congregates, without depending on paid or fully trackable channels.

  • Develop culturally fluent community content and voice: write and produce content that reads as native to each community (a Reddit post, a WhatsApp broadcast, a group meme) rather than as an ad, calibrated to the trust dynamics of expat and global professional audiences across LatAm and EU geographies.

  • Propose measurement approaches for hard-to-track channels: contribute proxy metrics, promo codes, and mixed-method measurement ideas in partnership with Business Analytics and the Growth PM, so channel impact can be argued with evidence, not anecdote.

  • Run experimentation in a test-and-learn model, in lockstep with the Growth PM: translate community insight into testable hypotheses and campaign structures, working the same backlog and review cadence as the product side rather than a parallel one.

  • Operate no-code/low-code growth tooling: build and maintain automation for community outreach and content distribution that scales without heavy engineering dependency.

  • Scout and pilot emerging channels: track and test next-wave channels (GEO/generative-engine optimization, new community platforms) before they become mainstream growth levers.

  • Bring a strong marketing point of view: partner with the Growth PM to shape the growth thesis for your workstream, and represent the marketing perspective clearly to product, data, and country stakeholders.

We are looking for a person who

  • Has solid experience in growth marketing, community marketing, or lifecycle marketing, including direct ownership of closed-community or grassroots acquisition (private groups, forums, and other low-visibility community channels) in consumer, fintech, or marketplace businesses.

  • Demonstrated track record contributing to attribution workarounds for channels with incomplete or no native tracking. This is a hands-on execution role.

  • Is comfortable operating without clean data. Makes calls with proxy evidence and mixed-method reasoning, and runs a disciplined test-and-learn cadence rather than waiting for perfect attribution.

  • Cultural fluency across LatAm and/or EU audiences, particularly expat, diaspora, and global-professional segments. Prior experience with global expansion companies or community-led growth companies is a differentiator.

  • Strong influence skills; able to represent the marketing point of view to Product and Analytics stakeholders, and make the case for channel and content calls as a senior individual contributor.

  • Fluency in English is mandatory. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is a strong advantage. Nice to have: French, German, or Italian

  • Strategic Acumen: Links the growth-hacking workstream's near-term channel bets to Nu Global's broader expansion strategy, and helps the Growth PM and stakeholders see that connection too.

  • Analytical Ability: Analyzes incomplete, unstructured channel data with little oversight; turns it into recommendations that hold up when someone in Business Analytics pushes back.

  • Stakeholder Relationship & Management: Builds and sustains trust with Product, Business Analytics, and country teams independently; manages conflicting priorities between marketing's channel bets and product's roadmap without escalating every time.

  • Marketing Knowledge & Product Influence: Synthesizes community and cultural insight into marketing objectives, and advocates for product changes where the community signal warrants it.

  • Customer Marketing: Acts as a primary advocate for community trust dynamics in cross-functional discussions; translates research and behavioral signal into concrete channel and content decisions.

  • AI Fluency: Builds or guides no-code/low-code AI automation for growth tooling; evaluates AI initiatives on ROI, effort, and risk rather than adopting tools for their own sake.

Location for this opportunity

  • Miami, United States

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Head of Design (Hands-On), Digital Assets

We are building open money and open financial services — not "crypto."

The Digital Assets team at Nu is reimagining how a financial services platform can use blockchain technology to solve real problems for real people — without ever making customers think about the blockchain at all. We have deliberately renamed ourselves from Crypto to Digital Assets, and we have effectively banned the word "crypto" internally. We do not do crypto for crypto's sake. We do blockchain banking.

The reference point is Apple Pay. It runs on cryptography, public and private keys, and secure tokenization inside a secure enclave. Apple never says any of that. It says "on device," and "it just works." That is the standard for everything we ship.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on design leader to join the Digital Assets team in Palo Alto. You will be the lead design voice for a genuinely new category: making digital assets — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and stablecoins — as simple, accessible, and trusted as a debit card swipe.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer product design, financial innovation, and zero-to-one invention. Much of what you will design has never existed in consumer form before. You will not be asked to study what the incumbents did; the explicit instruction is to carve a new path.

What You Will Design

  • The buy, hold, and sell experience for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Digital Dollars, etc. — designed to feel intuitive, familiar, and clear from the first interaction.

  • Earning, also known as staking: an experience that lets customers put eligible digital assets to work and earn rewards with clarity, control, and trust — without exposing the protocol mechanics underneath.

  • Onchain transfers and payments: sending, receiving, and using digital assets in ways that feel as simple and dependable as moving money today, while the underlying blockchain complexity stays out of the customer’s way.

  • The invisible infrastructure layer that powers core functionality across the entire company, including the US build.

  • Both the customer experience and the platform that other teams will draw on for future launches.

  • New ways for people to own, move, use, and grow value across financial products and borders — shaping a flexible foundation for what open money can become without being constrained by today’s conventions.

What We Are Looking For

  • Consumer instincts over crypto fluency. Deep domain experience in crypto is not the point here — and can even work against you. If your instinct is to explain custody models or gas fees to a customer, this is not the seat.

  • Mobile expertise is a must-have. There is no desktop app in Brazil; effectively no web. Strong recent mobile work is non-negotiable, and a primarily B2B or enterprise background is a hard fit.

  • Zero-to-one experience. You have designed products that did not exist before, where there were no references to copy, and you thrived in the ambiguity.

  • A product marketing mindset. You care about the words, the positioning, and how it feels — not just the design elements. Our touchstone is "a thousand songs in your pocket," decided before the product was designed.

  • The ability to hide complexity. You have made something complicated feel obvious and delightful. Products that resonate with us: Cash App, Apple, the Tesla app, Duolingo, Wise, Revolut.

  • Fintech experience is a plus, never a requirement. We will teach you the compliance, legal, and regulatory ropes. What we cannot teach is the instinct to dream a magical experience first.

  • A short line to the business. The design team reports directly to the GM of the business unit. For a senior designer, that means unusual room to shape strategy rather than receive it.

How We Work

  • Dream first. The hiring manager's framing is: "Dream the magical experience first. We'll tell you afterwards what's not allowed."

  • No desktop-first. Everything is mobile-first, consumer-first.

  • No copy-and-paste. No copying from Coinbase or Robinhood. We are deliberately different.

  • The US is part of the trajectory. You will be shaping work that serves the next phase of global growth.

The Team

You will report directly to Michael Rihani, GM of the Digital Assets business unit. Michael is a product leader with close to twenty years of experience, including four years at Apple on Apple Pay, leading Bitcoin and consumer financial services at Cash App and Coinbase, and directing Supercharging UX and Bitcoin payments at Tesla. He believes the biggest thing the industry is missing is storytellers and design people who can make the technology disappear.

Interview Process

1. Portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO, Nu) — asynchronous

2. Live portfolio presentation with 2-3 design leaders and/or senior designers (~1 hour)

3. Hiring manager interview with Michael Rihani

4. Possible additional interviews. This interview process is subject to change, and may evolve with the hiring process. We appreciate your flexibility.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Lead Software Engineer , you will serve as a technical authority across entire business domains, shaping company-wide engineering strategy and driving the architectural evolution of large-scale distributed systems that power our core platform for tens of millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that top-tier technical leaders who are eager to learn will thrive here — and we will support your mastery of Clojure as our main backend language.


You’ll be Responsible for

  1. Architectural Leadership: Defining long-term technical vision and architecture roadmaps across business area, balancing immediate business goals with long-term system sustainability.

  2. Strategic Alignment: Partnering with Leaders to translate team business strategy into scalable engineering systems and technical bets.

  3. Engineering Excellence: Setting and raising the technical bar for the entire engineering organization through systemic improvements, architectural reviews, and best-practice frameworks.

  4. High-Impact Execution: Hands-on leadership in designing, prototyping, and executing on the most complex, high-risk, or foundational systems in the company.

  5. Mentorship & Talent Growth: Mentoring engineers

  6. Cross-Organizational Resilience: Establishing team practices for observability, failure domain isolation, disaster recovery, and incident resolution for critical systems

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  1. Extensive Experience: 8+ years of experience engineering complex digital products

  2. Domain-Scale Expertise: Mastery of distributed systems design, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and failure-mode analysis in systems handling high concurrency and millions of active users.

  3. Cross-Team Influence: Demonstrated history of steering large-scale technical initiatives, aligning competing priorities across multiple engineering teams.

  4. Leadership & Sponsorship: Experience mentoring engineers

  5. Business Acumen & Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs, risk profiles, and architectural decisions

  6. Language Proficiency: Advanced English skills (both written and spoken)

 

Work Setup

Location

Buenos Aires, Argentina
Argentina · Avenida del Libertador General San Martín 1000 – Vicente López
Hybrid

 

Our Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life outside of work. They include:

  • Chance of earning equity

  • Health Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • NuCare

  • International business travel insurance

  • NuLanguage

  • Vacations

  • Parental leaves

  • Work from home allowance

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.

 

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As the Senior Media Specialist - Marketing (US), you will drive Nu's paid media strategy in the US, translating business goals into full-funnel media plans across digital and offline channels, and helping build the measurement infrastructure needed to prove what's working. This role exists to help Nu grow efficiently and profitably in a market that's still early — you'll be one of the first people building the paid media engine for the US from the ground up, working independently to stand up the building blocks that don't yet exist.

You will propose, build, implement, optimize, and measure paid media campaigns end to end, operating in a test-and-learn model to find the most efficient paths to reach and convert audiences — with particular focus on the mass affluent target, reaching them in the key demographic and geographic areas aligned to Nu's product offerings, from national brand campaigns down to regional, state, and city-level activation.

This role also works closely with Business Analytics, Finance, and other marketing teams to build the first paid media measurement models for the US, translating spend into credible ROI and ROAS reporting that can hold up under scrutiny.

Key responsibilities and Expectations

  • Propose, build, implement, optimize, and measure paid media strategies across digital and offline channels (search, social, programmatic, video, CTV/OOH, direct mail, and others), matched to the right objective and funnel stage.

  • Set up the foundational building blocks for US paid media: platform accounts, tracking, tagging, and reporting infrastructure, working self-directed since much of this doesn't yet exist.

  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn model: design experiments across channel, audience, and creative to find efficient paths to growth, and scale what works.

  • Target and reach the mass affluent audience with precision: focus spend on the demographic and geographic areas that align to Nu's product offerings, balancing reach with efficiency.

  • Partner with Business Analytics and Finance to build the first paid media measurement models for the US: contribute to ROI/ROAS frameworks, incrementality approaches, and reporting that connects media spend to business outcomes.

  • Translate business goals into media strategy: work with brand, growth, and other marketing teams to turn objectives (awareness, acquisition, specific product goals) into channel plans and budget allocation.

  • Manage external media and creative agencies, and work directly with media platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, and others) for platform best practices, beta access, and troubleshooting.

  • Bring a strong media point of view, grounded in external benchmarks and references where Nu's own US data doesn't yet exist: partner with marketing, product, and finance stakeholders to shape the US paid media approach, and represent that point of view clearly across teams.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 6–9 years in paid media or performance marketing, including hands-on ownership of multi-channel campaigns across national and regional/local levels.

  • Industry Experience: Background in tech, e-commerce, mobile app, or financial services is a strong plus — particularly experience with mobile app install/conversion campaigns and mobile measurement (SDKs, MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Adjust), given Nu's app-first product.

  • Technical Expertise: Deep hands-on experience across digital platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, programmatic/DSPs, and others) and offline channels (TV, OOH, direct mail, radio), with fluency in ROI, ROAS, CPA, and other core media and marketing metrics.

  • Mindset: Highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and rigorous in campaign execution and reporting; self-directed and independent, comfortable building measurement and infrastructure from scratch, and runs a test-and-learn cadence rather than waiting for perfect data.

  • Agency & Platform Management: Proven experience managing external media and creative agencies, plus direct working relationships with media platforms themselves, including scoping, performance accountability, and budget oversight.

  • Market Knowledge: Experience planning and executing media at national, regional, and state/city levels in the US, with the ability to identify and prioritize the geographic and demographic areas that best align to a mass affluent target, and to bring outside benchmarks to fill data gaps.

  • Communication: Strong influence skills; able to represent the media point of view to marketing, finance, and analytics stakeholders as a senior individual contributor.

  • Languages: Fluent or native English required. Portuguese and/or Spanish preferred.

Core Skills

  • Strategic Acumen: Links near-term paid media bets to Nu's broader US growth strategy, and helps stakeholders see that connection too.

  • Analytical Ability: Analyzes performance and spend data with rigor and little oversight; turns it into recommendations that hold up when Finance or Business Analytics pushes back.

  • Stakeholder Relationship & Management: Builds and sustains trust with Business Analytics, Finance, and other marketing teams independently; manages conflicting priorities between paid media bets and broader marketing plans without escalating every time.

  • Marketing Knowledge & Channel Influence: Synthesizes performance data and market insight into media objectives, and advocates for budget or channel shifts where the data warrants it.

  • Customer & Audience Insight: Acts as a primary advocate for precise, well-targeted audience strategy in cross-functional discussions; translates data and market signal into concrete channel, budget, and creative decisions.

  • AI Fluency: Uses AI tools to improve targeting, creative testing, or media efficiency; evaluates AI initiatives on ROI, effort, and risk rather than adopting tools for their own sake.

 

Work Setup

Miami, US

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

At Nubank, software engineers sit at the intersection of data, intelligence, and scale. We build systems that process millions of decisions daily, from fraud detection to credit modeling and increasingly, we do this powered by AI. Machine learning is embedded across our core products: in how we assess risk, personalize experiences, and automate decisions at scale. Engineers here don't just consume AI capabilities; they help shape how intelligence is built, deployed, and maintained in production.

We do it with engineering rigor, autonomy, and a deep focus on impact. Our engineers work across the full spectrum: designing data pipelines and architectures, deploying and maintaining ML models in production, and building the distributed systems and platforms that power our products. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices across our entire stack. While we value candidates familiar with our technologies, we're confident that engineers who join Nubank will learn and grow alongside our team:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, leveraging functional programming and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput event-driven architectures for inter-service communication

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into cloud-native infrastructure

  • Distributed transactional systems built on Datomic, modeling complex business domains with immutable data and strong consistency

  • Modern data platforms built on ETL/ELT best practices, with robust monitoring and observability

Our Software Engineers

  • Work with large scale distributed systems

  • Collaborate with building microservices

  • Design, build and maintain robust data pipelines, distributed systems and ML-enabled solutions, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance at scale

  • Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Lead data and engineering projects end-to-end — from requirements gathering and stakeholder alignment to delivery and iteration

  • Contribute to the design, documentation, maintenance and optimization of our data codebase, platforms and tooling

  • Translate business needs into data products and technical solutions aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term strategy

  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to define strategies and deliver high-impact solutions

  • Share knowledge, mentor peers and contribute to engineering and data literacy initiatives across Nubank

What We're Looking For

  • Deep programming experience in one or more general-purpose languages (e.g. Python, Clojure, Scala, Java), with a track record of guiding technical decisions and raising engineering standards

  • Experience designing analytical data environments and data engineering solutions: pipelines, ETL/ELT, and data modeling

  • Understanding of ML model lifecycle, from training and evaluation to deployment and monitoring

  • Experience guiding the technical design of distributed systems, microservices and asynchronous architectures

  • Strong communication skills to influence and align both technical and business stakeholders

  • Passion for building and leading the delivery of high-quality software and data products

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart)

  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and feature engineering pipelines

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar)

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices: testing, clean code, documentation

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance, Medical Plan and Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform

  • Extended Parental Leave, Daycare Allowance and Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.

For more details, visit building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of multiple teams, driving the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems that serve millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

You will build and evolve:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS

  • Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.


You'll be responsible for

  • Working with large-scale distributed systems and understanding their broad architecture and trade-offs

  • Setting technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

  • Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Mentoring engineers across teams and helping maintain a high technical bar organization-wide

  • Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

  • Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your teams

  • Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

  • Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across team services

  • Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

  • Focusing primarily on backend applications, while being open to contributing to mobile and frontend development according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 8 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

  • A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

  • A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams, even without direct authority

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

  • Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks, and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Advanced English skills

Location

Mexico City, Mexico.

 

Our Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life outside of work. For Mexico, they include:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus (“Aguinaldo”) of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Location: U.S./Canada East Coast, including New York City, or Brazil (Eastern timezone for Europe-compatibility)

---

The Role

We're launching a brand-new global account into dozens of markets at once — multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a suite of debit cards, built for people whose work and family span borders. The infrastructure underneath is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that complexity is fully abstracted. What the customer feels is a delightful, magical consumer product — as simple and effortless as anything Apple makes.

This is the project where every new thing at Nu lands first: the Magic App, the next evolution of the design system, new components and patterns. You'd have unusual room to experiment, iterate, and push the system forward rather than just consume it. The benchmark isn't the domestic market — it's global leaders like Revolut and Wise, and we're building to raise the bar past them.

As Head of Design for this initiative, you'll own the design function for the entire project. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a team, but you'll also stay deeply in the craft — prototyping, refining, and setting the standard by doing, not just by directing. We need someone whose work itself is the bar.

What You'll Do

* Lead the design function for Nu's most ambitious global expansion — a multi-currency account allowing transfers to 35+ countries.

* Set and hold the craft bar at a global standard, benchmarking against the best fintech products in the world (Revolut, Wise, and beyond).

* Stay hands-on. You manage people, but you're also in the work — shipping design, prototyping, and elevating every surface and interaction.

* Push the design system forward. This product is the proving ground for new components and patterns that flow back into Nu's global design system. You don't just use the system; you evolve it.

* Navigate the balance between creative freedom and organizational maturity — earning autonomy by influencing and persuading the central design organization, contributing patterns back to the system, and building bridges rather than working in isolation.

* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and the broader design organization to ship experiences that feel magical and effortless to customers across China, Italy, Spain, and dozens of other markets.

What We're Looking For

* Craft first. Extreme attention to detail and a portfolio that demonstrates world-class product design — the kind of work that stands out against Revolut, Wise, or Apple.

* A hands-on manager. You've led teams, but you still design. You set the bar by doing, not just by directing.

* Fintech-adjacent domain experience. You've worked in or around financial products — payments, cards, banking, digital assets, consumer finance. If you come from outside finance, you should have extraordinary craft and a track record of making complex products feel dead simple.

* A system-level collaborator. You know how to operate within a mature design organization — influencing the global system, contributing patterns, and partnering with central teams rather than working around them.

* A bar-raiser. You're not satisfied with "good enough." You push your team and yourself to the next level, especially when competing against the best in the world.

About the Product

A global account designed for people with cross-border lives — those who work across markets, have family in different countries, or need to move money internationally with ease. It offers multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a set of debit cards. The underlying technology is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that's invisible to the user. What they experience is a consumer product that feels as simple and delightful as anything Apple makes.

The product is launching nonlinearly into 35+ countries simultaneously — customers in China, Italy, Spain, and beyond. This is Nu's most ambitious global expansion to date, and the design bar must match the ambition.

Interview Process

1. Async portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO).

2. Live portfolio presentation (1 hour) — walkthrough of your best work with the design leadership team.

3. Hiring manager interview (45 min) with Thomaz Fortes and Thais Burin.

4. Final conversation with Ethan if needed.
