About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

We're hiring an experienced, curious Product Marketing Manager to shape how our products are positioned, launched and grown in Mexico. It's an individual contributor role that leads mostly through influence. You'll be the closest partner to the Product and Growth teams on narrative, go-to-market, segmentation and product consideration, and you'll run launches end-to-end. You'll use research, customer behavior and data to find barriers and opportunities, size their impact, and decide on audience, message, channels and investment. You'll join a small, ambitious team that works fast, iterates and uses AI heavily, and from day one you'll help shape roadmaps and full-funnel strategy. This is a high‑ownership role, changing the financial inclusion in Mexico.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Setting the strategy: turning company and product strategy into clear positioning, segmentation, and go-to-market choices: where we play, who we serve, and how we win in Mexico.

  • Owning the story end to end: building one consistent narrative across the product ecosystem, including campaigns, owned channels, paid media, influencers, customer journeys, and support.

  • Shaping the roadmap early: partnering with Product and Research from the start so customer needs, barriers, and proof points drive what we build and how we talk about it.

  • Leading launches: running GTM for new products and updates, and aligning cross-functional teams on investment, audiences, channels, messaging, and success metrics.

  • Knowing the customer deeply: understanding the lifecycle, segments, and jobs-to-be-done, and working with Product and Growth to make every journey coherent, on-brand, and relevant to Mexican customers.

  • Reading the market: maintaining a sharp view of Mexico's competitive landscape and turning research, data, and competitive signals into clear calls on what we say, build, and test next.

  • Building the operating system: establishing rituals for narrative development, launch readiness, prioritization, measurement, and quarterly planning.

  • Cutting through ambiguity: bringing clarity and sound judgment to cross-functional problems, balancing strategic quality with speed.

  • Raising the bar: codifying best practices and creating reusable playbooks that level up Product Marketing.

  • Working AI-first: using AI for writing, research, analysis, and workflow automation, and continually finding ways to move faster and go deeper.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • 5–8+ years in product marketing or very similar roles at consumer tech or fintech companies, including time as a PMM on high‑impact launches.

  • Proven track record owning end‑to‑end product or major feature launches with clear, quantified business impact.

  • Strong customer-insight judgment: you can combine qualitative research, quantitative data, market signals, and frontline feedback into a clear point of view.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools as a natural part of your day‑to‑day work.

  • Strategic GTM leadership: designing customer-led plans tailored to product tiering, with the operational excellence required to execute them effectively.

Nice to Have

  • Experience across multiple areas (e.g., growth, brand, lifecycle, paid) and working with senior cross‑functional stakeholders.

  • Experience using experimentation, lifecycle communications, or customer journey orchestration to drive activation and usage.

  • Experience working with product-led growth, digital platforms, or mobile applications.

 

Work Setup

Location

Mexico City, Mexico

Work model

Hybrid
Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Nubank is building a global Software Asset Management (SAM) capability to govern how software is requested, acquired, secured, provisioned, optimized, renewed, and retired across the company. Software is one of our largest and fastest-growing technology spend categories, and it carries real security, privacy, and audit exposure — every tool we buy creates licenses to optimize, access to control, contracts to honor, and data to protect.

We are looking for a senior individual contributor to lead this transformation globally. This role owns the design and implementation of Nubank's SAM operating model, working across Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), Information Security, IAM, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Data Protection, and business areas.

This is an IC6 role: you will lead through deep expertise, influence, and execution across multiple functions and geographies. You will not be expected to manage a large team directly; instead, you will set the technical and operational direction for SAM and enable partner teams to execute consistently.

You own a clear goal: a trusted, governed, and cost-efficient global software portfolio — with complete inventory, right-sized licenses, controlled access, audit-ready evidence, and measurable savings.

You'll be responsible for

  • Leading the global implementation of Nubank's Software Asset Management framework, from intake through acquisition, lifecycle management, renewal, and decommissioning.

  • Establishing ETS as the operational owner of the software portfolio and creating clear interfaces with ITSec, IAM, Procurement, Legal, DPO, Finance, and business owners.

  • Implementing an intake-first operating model in which software needs are assessed for catalog fit, duplication, build-vs-buy, security, open source governance, and data-protection requirements before commercial negotiation begins.

  • Defining and operationalizing the Software Catalog as the single source of truth for software assets, owners, licenses, spend, contracts, renewals, usage, risk classification, and access posture.

  • Driving the separation of license management from access management, partnering with IAM to ensure least-privilege access, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and reliable license reclamation.

  • Designing risk-tiered workflows for SaaS, AI tools, FOSS, browser extensions, connectors, pilots, and exceptions.

  • Establishing lifecycle automation, including renewal alerts, inactivity-based reclamation, ownership reassignment, offboarding workflows, and Shadow IT detection/remediation.

  • Leading the Software Asset Selection Committee and defining decision criteria, escalation paths, exception handling, and governance cadence.

  • Building global SAM standards, policies, RACI, controls, SLAs, playbooks, and reporting practices that meet Nubank's security, regulatory, and audit needs.

  • Partnering with Procurement to improve vendor negotiations through usage data, right-sizing, duplicate-tool consolidation, and early renewal decisions.

  • Defining and reporting the SAM performance framework: inventory completeness, license utilization, reclaimed spend, duplicate-tool reduction, renewal readiness, intake cycle time, access-review completion, and Shadow IT trends.

  • Leading phased adoption across countries and business units, balancing global standards with local regulatory and operating needs.

  • Serving as Nubank's internal subject-matter expert for SAM, ITAM, SaaS governance, and software lifecycle controls.

    We are looking for a person who has

    • Significant experience leading Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, SaaS Management, or adjacent enterprise technology governance programs in a complex global environment.

    • A recognized SAM/ITAM certification, such as IAITAM CSAM, CITAM, or equivalent certification/experience.

    • Proven experience implementing or significantly evolving a SAM operating model, including tooling, process design, governance, integrations, and adoption.

    • Strong knowledge of software licensing, SaaS contracts, renewals, vendor management, license optimization, and audit/compliance requirements.

    • Practical experience with SAM platforms such as Zylo, Flexera, ServiceNow SAM, Snow, SaaS Management platforms, or similar.

    • Experience working with IAM and identity platforms such as Okta, including the distinction between license entitlement and application access.

    • Ability to design scalable workflows and automation across HRIS, IAM, procurement, ticketing, catalog, finance, and security systems.

    • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to turn complex operational issues into clear decisions, trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.

    • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Engineering, and Product without direct authority.

    • Fluency in English; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.

This role owns the design and implementation of Nubank's SAM operating model, working across Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), Information Security, IAM, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Data Protection, and business areas. Implementing an intake-first operating model in which software needs are assessed for catalog fit, duplication, build-vs-buy, security, open source governance, and data-protection requirements before commercial negotiation begins. - Leading phased adoption across countries and business units, balancing global standards with local regulatory and operating needs. - Serving as Nubank's internal subject-matter expert for SAM, ITAM, SaaS governance, and software lifecycle controls. About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every Nubank office runs on an IT Room that most people never see. Power distribution, cooling, structured cabling and fiber are the layer that keeps thousands of Nubankers connected and working — and when that layer fails, entire sites stop.

Nubank's office portfolio is growing across countries, and today each site has been built to its own standard. The ETS team owns the physical layer of these environments — structured cabling, optical fiber and, in partnership with other teams, power distribution, HVAC, fire protection and physical security systems. This role exists to bring one engineering standard to all of them.

As Lead Infrastructure Engineer for Global Office IT Physical Infra, you are the technical reference for IT Room infrastructure across Nubank's global office portfolio. You assess and size environments, define the technical specifications new sites and expansions must meet, and coordinate the vendors and construction teams who build them — so that an IT Room in Mexico City, São Paulo or Miami is built, documented and operated the same way.

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical authority rather than direct reports. You set the standard, you review the projects against it, and you catch the gaps before they become outages.

You'll be responsible for

  • Assessing and sizing IT Rooms for expansion and improvement projects, defining the technical and physical specifications that meet real capacity needs, optimize resource use, and hold to operational standards.

  • Executing deployment projects for new environments and expansions in compliance with established technical specifications, and coordinating deployment logistics end to end while ensuring quality standards throughout.

  • Acting as the interface between internal teams and external vendors — translating business needs into infrastructure requirements, work orders and technical specifications — and managing those vendors and service providers to quality, deadline and compliance with Nubank's standards.

  • Coordinating with construction and engineering teams during the build-out of new offices, ensuring IT Room specifications are met from the earliest project phases rather than retrofitted later.

  • Creating and maintaining clear, current technical documentation — standards, procedures, capacity plans, topology diagrams, bayfaces — so that every site is aligned and auditable.

  • Ensuring alignment between physical infrastructure and IT operations, including cabling changes, equipment installation, capacity planning and structured cabling terminations.

  • Driving continuous improvement in the availability, resilience and efficiency of IT Room physical infrastructure: HVAC, structured cabling, optical fiber, power distribution, generators, UPS units and fire protection.

  • Supporting the assessment of the global IT Room portfolio across corporate offices, identifying gaps and standardization opportunities across multiple sites and countries.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Solid experience with mission-critical environment infrastructure, including the deployment and operation of physical infrastructure in corporate offices or data center facilities.

  • Strong hands-on command of mission-critical infrastructure systems: HVAC and air conditioning, structured cabling, optical fiber, low-voltage power distribution, UPS units, generators, and fire detection and suppression.

  • Proven experience coordinating deployment projects that run structured cabling, electrical, mechanical and civil scopes simultaneously.

  • Experience managing vendors and service providers on infrastructure projects — from technical specification through execution and acceptance.

  • A consistent track record of creating and maintaining clear technical documentation for infrastructure standards, procedures and projects.

  • A completed degree in Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering

  • Advanced English enough to work with international vendors, standards and distributed teams.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD.

  • Availability to work in a hybrid model and to travel to Nubank office locations for site assessments and deployments.

Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

Mexico City, Mexico


Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage — Our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the role

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts and regions, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cost-efficient, without ever becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Senior Cloud Network Engineer on our Cloud Network platform engineering team, you will design, build and operate the cloud network that Nubank’s engineering teams rely on. You will treat the network as software: automated, tested and versioned. This is an IC5 role: you lead through technical depth, design quality and influence, not direct reports. You will be part of a global engineering organization and work with teammates across countries, so collaboration in English is part of everyday work.


You’ll be responsible for

  • Designing and evolving connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region and hybrid-cloud topologies, making sound architectural decisions in designs that span multiple teams.

  • Building and maintaining the network platform as code (Terraform or similar), with strong standards for testing, code review and reusable modules.

  • Owning the operational health of the platform in your scope: leading incident response, driving postmortems and following through on the tech debt they uncover.

  • Promoting safe change on the network: gradual rollouts, monitoring and fast rollback.

  • Defining observability for the platform, with monitoring and SLAs that surface issues before customers feel them.

  • Owning the network security posture of your scope, including segmentation and standards such as PCI DSS, with controls that hold up under audit.

  • Simplifying the topology over time through consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, balancing scalability, maintainability and cost.

  • Evaluating build vs. buy decisions with data on stability, scalability and cost.

  • Mentoring other engineers, taking part in hiring, and documenting decisions so knowledge travels across teams.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Production experience with public cloud networking, preferably AWS: Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns and network firewalls. Experience with Azure or GCP networking is also valued.

  • Experience connecting cloud and on-premises environments: hybrid connectivity, BGP and dynamic routing, IP address management, load balancers and firewalls, planning, deploying and troubleshooting at scale.

  • Coding and automation skills (Python, Go, Java, .NET), using infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), Git, CI/CD and containers to build and operate network infrastructure.

  • A background in network engineering, SRE, DevOps or software engineering. What matters is hands-on public cloud networking experience.

  • Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high-impact failures that cross team boundaries.

  • An analytical mindset focused on root causes and continuous improvement.

  • English proficiency to read, write and lead discussions across time zones.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Team

The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense.
As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company's credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently — participating end-to-end in the model development process, including implementation, monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data, and supporting Finance accounting teams.
Our team's models feed the financial statements of the Holding under IFRS 9, and, as Nubank expands into the United States, under US GAAP as well

About the Role
As a Credit Risk Expert focused on the US, you'll be the senior technical authority on US GAAP credit-loss and CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses) methodology within our Credit Risk team. Nubank's US expansion requires expected-credit-loss models that meet US regulatory and accounting standards.

You'll govern local US CECL models: assessing and identifying gaps, reviewing risks, and driving an implementation plan — hands-on where needed, working through the team rather than alone. It is also expected that you become the team's standing focal point for US-specific credit regulation.

This is a specialist, individual-contributor role, — but you'll be expected to share your knowledge to the rest of the team, along with senior stakeholders in Finance, Risk, and Product.

You’ll be Responsible for

  • Own the US GAAP / CECL methodology — be the team's definitive expert on how expected credit loss should be calculated and governed under US standards.

  • Assess and close regulatory gaps — evaluate our current state against what's required for the local US regulation; identify what's missing in model methodology, documentation, and governance, and drive the plan to close it.

  • Build models for new US portfolios — as new US products launch, build their expected-credit-loss models from the ground up, hands-on, including Development, Implementation and Monitoring process.

  • Close the explanatory gap between IFRS 9 and US GAAP models — advise on main drivers for differences between IFRS 9 and US GAAP results.

  • Transfer knowledge across the team — ensure US GAAP/CECL expertise doesn't stay siloed with you; coach and upskill teammates who will implement and maintain these models day to day.

  • Be the face of credit risk with US stakeholders — represent the team with local US leadership (CFO, CRO) and act as a primary point of contact with US regulators on credit and expected-loss matters.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Statistics, Math, or a related quantitative field.

  • Deep, hands-on experience building expected-credit-loss / provisioning models under US GAAP, specifically CECL (ASC 326).

  • Strong working knowledge of US credit risk regulatory expectations — what regulators, internal model risk teams, and external auditors scrutinize in ECL models.

  • Proven experience actually building models (not only reviewing or auditing them).

  • Strong communication skills and a demonstrated ability to transfer technical knowledge to non-specialists and teammates, rather than keeping it centralized.

  • Comfortable operating with high visibility across senior internal stakeholders (global credit leadership, first-line credit policy teams) and external stakeholders (local US leadership, regulators).

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to IFRS 9 or other international provisioning standards, and experience with model transitions between accounting frameworks.

  • Coding/technical skills sufficient to engage with model implementation (Python/SQL).

  • Experience mentoring or growing into people leadership.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role


Do you want to be part of the team redefining how millions of people interact with solutions that are part of their everyday lives?

We’re building a new way of doing things: simpler, more transparent, and more human. We’re looking for bilingual people who want to be part of Nu’s international expansion and help build a world-class customer experience operation from the ground up.

When you join our Talent Pool, your profile is saved for future opportunities. When a role aligned with your background opens up, we’ll contact you at the email you registered.

Shall we build the purple future together?

Important:

  • Signing up does not mean immediate participation in a selection process.

  • You’ll be considered for future roles as new positions open.

  • This is a great opportunity if you’re interested in customer service and customer experience (CX) in an international environment.

  • These positions are 100% on-site at our Bogotá, Colombia office.

  • Spanish plus at least one additional language (English, Portuguese, German, Italian, or French) is required, written and spoken. Your language skills will be evaluated during the hiring process.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Deliver first and second level customer support across chat, email, back-office, and phone channels, consistently meeting CX metrics and ensuring an outstanding customer experience in all supported languages.

  • Manage the CX knowledge base and training processes to ensure team members are equipped to handle all case types — including complex and escalation-worthy situations — with confidence.

  • Monitor CX metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and design and implement action plans to continuously improve performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Alert relevant stakeholders to operational needs and opportunities, including headcount requirements, training gaps, and people-related inputs.

  • Coordinate local initiatives with broader organizational and cross-functional efforts involving the Xpeer team, including support for new international market launches.

  • Ensure all customer excellence processes are documented, accessible, and kept up to date at the squad level.

  • Switch seamlessly across support squads and roles as the team grows and evolves, bringing consistency and energy to each area.

What we’re looking for

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in customer service or operations, ideally in high-volume, fast-paced environments.

  • A strong analytical, data-driven mindset: you read metrics, spot patterns, and turn insights into action.

  • Excellent people skills and a drive to create memorable experiences.

  • Comfort working across multiple tools, topics, and roles at the same time.

  • Currently studying for, or holding, a professional degree in any field.

  • Nice to have: more than one additional language, experience in knowledge base management or training coordination, and familiarity with CX platforms, ticketing tools, or support metrics dashboards.

Location for this Opportunity

Bogotá, Colombia.

This is a fully on-site role based at our Bogotá office.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage — Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

  • Explore how we build technology at Nubank

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the Role

You will play a crucial role in Nubank's balance sheet management. Your responsibilities will focus on optimizing risk-adjusted returns for the bank, involving daily assessment of the balance sheet, funding and liquidity needs, understanding trading positioning, and identifying potential levers to generate value for the company. Initially, you'll be tasked with the development and implementation of new products, and with supporting and automating traders' routines, but as you gain experience and develop, you will take on broader responsibilities across the desk.

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day treasury activities, including the sizing and implementation of cash and derivative trades, portfolio optimization, P&L calculation, and trading limit control.

  • Develop internal modeling and data visualization tools to support traders' decision-making processes and automate daily workflows.

  • Coordinate with other teams and build strong working partnerships, primarily with — but not limited to — ALM, Finance, and Risk teams.

  • Engage in ad-hoc projects related to new trading strategies, funding strategies, and other treasury solutions.

  • Contribute to the design, structuring, and implementation of new products, eventually including IRS, FX derivatives, and bond portfolios.

  • Act as a back up for the funding desk

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience in financial sector.

  • Market experience and technical knowledge of fixed-income products, understanding how financial instruments are priced and traded.

  • Prior experience with derivatives (IRS, FX) and bond portfolio management in a treasury or trading desk environment.

  • Experience designing and developing analytical tools or data visualizations.

  • Excellent analytical skills, with a meticulous and detail-oriented approach.

  • Technical proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages.

  • Ability to multi-task and adapt, delivering across a variety of topics in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

  • Fluent in English.

Certifications

  • AMIB 3/5 certification — required.

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

MEXICO JOBS:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank - [Reminder: Ops Teams don't have equity];

  • Food Card

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role
As Nu scales its footprint globally, seamless international money movement is a cornerstone of our growth. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own the overarching architecture for Nu’s global Remittance and Cross-Border Payment Platforms. In this role, you will sit at the strategic intersection of high-scale distributed backend systems, foreign exchange (FX) engines, international payment rails, and global compliance platforms. You won't just maintain existing pipelines, you will architect the foundation that enables instant, low-cost, multi-currency money movement for millions of users across borders.Your mission: maintain and grow a resilient, multi-country remittance engine that abstracts away complex global payment rails and regulatory requirements into simple, reliable platform capabilities.

What You Will Own & Build

  • Core Remittance Platform Architecture: Design and evolve the long-term technical vision for multi-currency money movement, FX rate locking, payout routing, and ledgering across international corridors.

  • Global Rail Integration Strategy: Architect plug-and-play integrations with global payout partners, banking networks, and local clearing rails (e.g., PIX, SPEI, FedNow, SWIFT) with ultra-high reliability and low latencies.

  • Resilient Ledgering & FX Management: Build transaction execution engines that guarantee exact-once delivery, deterministic ledger balancing, real-time liquidity management, and auditability under massive concurrency.

  • Compliance & Risk System Abstractions: Partner with AML, KYC, Sanctions Screening, and Regulatory Engineering teams to embed real-time screening seamlessly into payment paths without degrading user experience or throughput.

  • Technical RFC Leadership: Drive cross-organizational consensus on high-impact architectural decisions through detailed RFCs, design reviews, and technical documentation.

  • Engineering Mentorship: Multiply organizational velocity by mentoring senior engineers across payments squads in distributed systems principles, resilience engineering, and payment domain knowledge.

What We Are Looking For

  • Tenure in Backend Software Engineering: Proven track record of designing, operating, and scaling highly available, mission-critical backend distributed platforms in demanding environments (e.g., fintech, payments, banking, or cloud platform infrastructure).

  • Deep Payments Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience building remittance systems, cross-border payments, multi-currency ledger engines, FX execution services, or integrations with international payment clearing systems.

  • Distributed Systems Mastery: High fluency with event-driven architectures, transactional consistency, distributed sagas/orchestration, double-entry accounting engines, and high-concurrency microservices.

  • Platform Mindset: Experience designing clean, developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and platform boundaries that enable product teams to quickly launch consumer-facing remittance journeys.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to act as a horizontal technical leader, writing comprehensive design documents (RFCs), guiding executive leadership on technical trade-offs, and building consensus across geographically distributed teams.

  • Language & Location: Fluent English is required for international engineering collaboration. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Roles are open in Brazil (hybrid model) or key US hubs.

Why Join Us?

You will join a world-class engineering organization that values technical depth, architectural clarity, and high execution speed. You will own the technology powering one of the most strategic growth vectors at Nu, building cross-border payment infrastructure that unlocks financial freedom for tens of millions of people.

[Hybrid / On-Site]

About the Role

Controllership team breaks the status quo by facing challenges from the perspective of technological innovation as a tool to automate and make our processes run more efficiently. Our goal is to build a strong and diverse team that looks to create something worthwhile. And has at its core values to pursue smart efficiency, this comes hand in hand with our drive to remain as a strategic partner for all cross chapters teams within NU Mexico.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Professional to operate the Back Office activities, focus on the local operation of a “NUBANK IBM” monitored by “CNBV”.

  • Compliance and settlement of market transactions through SPEI-SIAC and other commercial bank portals.

  • Compliance with each financial operation, those instructions come from the treasury team.

  • Banks funding to keep operating without risks / commercial banks + manage bank accounts.

  • Create controls over bank activities and enhance SOX controls.

  • Upload and analyze short-term cash flow, ensuring it is updated daily.

  • Manage SAP movements regarding bank movements, conciliations.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of industrial engineer, business administrator, economist, accounting or related degrees.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience leading the back office or financial operations in banks, regulated fintech entities.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English to keep connected the teams of treasury, back office and others in different geos.

  • Manage financial operations as: interbank loans, overnight operations, deposit auctions, management of securities, coupons and maturities, derivatives using financial applications and core banking.

  • Lead teams to operate and complete the operations mentioned above.

  • Knowledge of treasury processes: bank transfers, reconciliations, rate validation, interest calculations, margin calls and balance monitoring.

  • Experience in tools of the local market as: BANXICO SIAC system , SAGAPL, INDEVAL, SWIFT.

  • Experience in foreign operations and Mexican exchange rate regime.

  • Lead new product and features (processes that affects the cash management).

  • Regulatory Reports review or preparation for BANXICO and CNBV.

Mexico City , Mexico

Hybrid

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

As Senior Staff of Segment Management, you will lead the customer analytics and segment strategy work for one customer segment: understanding what these customers need, shaping what Nubank should do about it, and supporting the execution of customer lifecycle programs.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Be the guardian of the segment’s value proposition: make sure the strategy stays aligned with it and influence other teams, including global BUs, to move in the same direction;

  • Lead the analytics behind the segment strategy and annual plan, contributing to the short-term strategy (6 to 18 months) and turning it into tactical plans, prioritized bets and validated product concepts;

  • Lead teams across customer insight, segment strategy and customer lifecycle optimization, as one team with product, engineering and research partners. Mentor analysts and build successors;

  • Lead the analytics and execution of the customer lifecycle optimization programs of the segment, coordinating cross-sell and retention strategies in partnership with Marketing and Products, and measure their results;

  • Manage the team's resources and budget, and the risk of its regulatory and compliance deliverables;

  • Use AI to redesign how the team works: build AI-enabled workflows, share what works and drive adoption across the team;

  • Apply Nubank's canonical frameworks and metrics, guide technical discussions and set analytical standards, sharing what you learn with other teams.
    Understand our products and interactions with other areas, sustaining a fast and healthy decision making system, and leverage analytics and customer understanding to craft a competitive value proposition and strategy that address the customers’ most relevant pain points;

  • Do thorough investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by being diligent with the execution and performance monitoring of decisions and by assessing second-order impacts, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available. Integrate other disciplines (such as research, product and engineering) properly making sure customer needs are understood, both when proposing solutions and when assessing risks;

  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

  • Business sense: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

  • Customer obsession, influence and stakeholder management, including with global teams;

  • Experience in customer and behavioral analytics, supporting multiproduct market segment strategy and/or customer lifecycle optimization;

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing resources and budget, and developing talent;

  • Hands-on use of AI in analytics work, and the ability to drive its adoption in a team.

Our Benefits

BRAZIL JOBS:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank - [Reminder: Ops Teams don't have equity];

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

Once here, you will:

  • Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

  • Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

  • Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

  • Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

  • Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

  • Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

  • Experience in digital products;

  • Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

  • Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Machine Learning Engineer at Nubank

At Nubank, Machine Learning Engineers sit at the core of how we make decisions at scale. We build, train, and deploy models that drive credit, fraud, risk, personalization decisions and a growing set of AI-native experiences for millions of customers every day. We do it with engineering rigor, statistical depth, and a deep focus on impact.

Our MLEs work across the full modeling lifecycle: framing business problems as ML problems, engineering features, training and validating models, and deploying and monitoring them in production. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

Increasingly, that work also includes Generative AI and Agentic Engineering. Depending on the problem, our engineers design and build systems that combine models, tools, workflows, evaluation loops, and human oversight to solve real business tasks reliably in production.

We strive for state-of-the-art ML practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.

  • Large-scale model training and experimentation pipelines

  • Feature engineering and feature stores feeding both batch and real-time models

  • Model deployment and serving in production, with monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Distributed data processing for training datasets at scale

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS and Kubernetes

  • Experiment tracking, model versioning, and reproducibility tooling

  • A robust data platform built on modern ETL/ELT practices

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’re expected to:

  • Directly contribute to Nu Colombia’s strategy and performance mainly by building forecasting models and models to assess and decide on marketing investments

  • Frame ambiguous business problems as well-defined modeling problems

  • Design, build and validate machine learning models, ensuring statistical rigor and business relevance

  • Engineer and maintain features and datasets used for training and inference

  • Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Lead modeling projects end-to-end — from problem framing and stakeholder alignment to delivery, monitoring and iteration

  • Translate business needs into modeling strategies aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term goals

What We're Looking For

  • Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning theory and modeling techniques (e.g. regression, tree-based models, deep learning)

  • Programming experience in Python and familiarity with ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost)

  • Experience training, validating, and tuning models, with solid understanding of overfitting, bias-variance tradeoff and evaluation metrics

  • Understanding of the ML model lifecycle, from training and evaluation to deployment and monitoring

  • Ability to write efficient SQL queries and work with analytical data environments

  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Passion for building high-quality, production-grade models

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices and asynchronous architectures

  • Experience with feature stores, MLOps tooling and experiment tracking (e.g. MLflow, Feast, Airflow)

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart)

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar)

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices: testing, clean code, documentation

Core Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the Role

You’ll be part of Nu’s global expansion one of the most exciting chapters in our story. As we enter new international markets, customer experience is our most powerful differentiator, and this role sits at the heart of it.

As a Customer Experience Analyst on our internationalization team, you’ll be a founding member of a CX operation built from scratch in a brand-new country. That means you’ll do more than handle customer interactions — you’ll help shape how we operate, train, and grow across borders. From delivering mind-blowingly great support to identifying process gaps and turning customer feedback into business insight, your work will directly influence what Nu looks like for customers in new markets around the world.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about people, and is excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up — with the full backing of a global platform behind them.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Deliver first and second level customer support across chat, email, back-office, and phone channels, consistently meeting CX metrics and ensuring an outstanding customer experience in all supported languages.

  • Manage the CX knowledge base and training processes to ensure team members are equipped to handle all case types — including complex and escalation-worthy situations — with confidence.

  • Monitor CX metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and design and implement action plans to continuously improve performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Alert relevant stakeholders to operational needs and opportunities, including headcount requirements, training gaps, and people-related inputs.

  • Coordinate local initiatives with broader organizational and cross-functional efforts involving the Xpeer team, including support for new international market launches.

  • Ensure all customer excellence processes are documented, accessible, and kept up to date at the squad level.

  • Switch seamlessly across support squads and roles as the team grows and evolves, bringing consistency and energy to each area.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in customer service or operations roles, ideally in high-volume or fast-paced environments.

  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and German.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to read metrics, spot patterns, and turn insights into action.

  • Excellent people skills: you genuinely enjoy engaging with customers and colleagues from diverse backgrounds, and you go the extra mile to create memorable experiences.

  • Comfort working across multiple tools, topics, and roles simultaneously — multitasking comes naturally to you.

  • Studying for or holding a professional degree in any field.

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in more than one additional language from the list above.

  • Experience with knowledge base management or training coordination.

  • Familiarity with CX platforms, ticketing tools, or support metrics dashboards.

Location for this Opportunity

Bogotá, Colombia.

This is a fully on-site role based at our Bogotá office.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage — Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Global Marketing at Nu is growing quickly, from the launch of our global partnerships with Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 and Inter Miami at the beginning of this year to launching our Nu US business and our Nu Global product in September. As Business Analyst in Global Marketing you will build the measurement capability from the ground up and own data and insights for the team. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will choose the methods, set the standards, and decide what we measure and how. You will work closely with the Global Partnerships Managers for MF1 and IMCF, the Paid Media Specialist, the Growth lead, the Research team, and Product Business Analysts.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Lead Media Mix Modeling: Scope, help build and run MMM for middle and upper funnel paid media together with an agency. Actively contribute to the model design, own data inputs and turn the outputs into budget and optimization recommendations the Global Marketing team can act on.

  • Set up geo testing: Design and run geo experiments to measure incrementality Define hypotheses, market selection, sample sizes, duration and guardrails, and use the results to calibrate the MMM

  • Build ROAS and ROI models: Create models for marketing activities across Nu US, Nu Global and our global partnerships, so each investment can be compared on the same basis

  • Build full-funnel attribution: Define how marketing activity connects to customer acquisition and activation, from awareness through conversion. Agree one methodology with the product BAs and the Growth Lead

  • Connect research to business impact: Work with the research team to link brand, audience and customer insights to measurable outcomes, so qualitative findings influence marketing investment decisions

  • Own data and insights for Global Marketing: Be the single point of ownership for core marketing metrics and the dashboards leadership uses. Define the metrics, keep them consistent across teams, and make sure the team works from a single source of truth

  • Turn analysis into decisions: Take ambiguous business questions, structure the data, and give clear, executive-ready recommendations on where to invest and A/B test

  • Partner across the business: Align with research, product BAs, paid media and Finance on definitions, methods and priorities

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Marketing measurement depth: Proven hands-on experience building or leading Media Mix Modeling, geo or incrementality testing. You have taken models from design to a decision someone acted on, and you can communicate and show the results.

  • ROI/ROAS ownership: You have built the models that show where marketing spend works and where it needs adjustment and testing. You can explain the assumptions, limitations and results to a diverse audience.

  • Technical skills: Knowledge in Python, SQL, Databricks, Airflow, AWS or other Cloud.

  • Senior judgment: You are proactive, set your own priorities and behave like an owner not a renter.

  • Research and data fluency: You are comfortable combining qualitative and quantitative inputs, and you know how to turn brand and customer research into something testable and actionable.

  • Executive communication: You turn complex findings into short, clear stories that influence senior stakeholders.

  • Cross-functional partnership: Experience working with marketing and product teams in a fast-moving environment, ideally across more than one market or region.

  • Comfortable with AI-enabled workflows: You already use AI tools in your work, you know its limitations and use it to your advantage while exercising critical thinking

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run — while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Senior Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

You'll be responsible for

  • Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

  • Support complex network projects and processes end to end — working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

  • Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

  • Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

  • Promoting a culture of safe change — feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback — applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

  • Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

  • Defining observability for the platform — robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

  • Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

  • Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

  • Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

  • Participating in hiring as a core part of the role, contributing to function-wide taskforces and initiatives, and documenting decisions so that knowledge travels across teams, not just within yours.

We are looking for a person who has

• Strong software engineering foundations and solid coding skills (Python, Go, Java, .NET etc.), with experience building and maintaining production-grade systems..

• Solid hands-on experience with cloud computing (AWS preferred) in production environments, including core services such as VPC, IAM, load balancing, DNS and managed connectivity services..

• Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar)..

• Experience designing, deploying and operating distributed systems with a focus on reliability and cost efficiency..

• Interest in specializing in cloud networking and connectivity. Prior network experience is not required; we will help you build that depth..

• An analytical profile: you go after root causes and propose solutions that hold, working in a continuous improvement environment..

• Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences..

• English proficiency to read, write and collaborate across time zones.

Nice to have

• Experience with incident response and root cause analysis in cloud environments..

• Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (hybrid connectivity, segmentation, firewalls)..

• Experience with observability stacks and security/compliance standards (PCI DSS)..

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the Role

You’ll be part of Nu’s global expansion one of the most exciting chapters in our story. As we enter new international markets, customer experience is our most powerful differentiator, and this role sits at the heart of it.

As a Customer Experience Analyst on our internationalization team, you’ll be a founding member of a CX operation built from scratch in a brand-new country. That means you’ll do more than handle customer interactions — you’ll help shape how we operate, train, and grow across borders. From delivering mind-blowingly great support to identifying process gaps and turning customer feedback into business insight, your work will directly influence what Nu looks like for customers in new markets around the world.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about people, and is excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up — with the full backing of a global platform behind them.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Deliver first and second level customer support across chat, email, back-office, and phone channels, consistently meeting CX metrics and ensuring an outstanding customer experience in all supported languages.

  • Manage the CX knowledge base and training processes to ensure team members are equipped to handle all case types — including complex and escalation-worthy situations — with confidence.

  • Monitor CX metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and design and implement action plans to continuously improve performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Alert relevant stakeholders to operational needs and opportunities, including headcount requirements, training gaps, and people-related inputs.

  • Coordinate local initiatives with broader organizational and cross-functional efforts involving the Xpeer team, including support for new international market launches.

  • Ensure all customer excellence processes are documented, accessible, and kept up to date at the squad level.

  • Switch seamlessly across support squads and roles as the team grows and evolves, bringing consistency and energy to each area.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in customer service or operations roles, ideally in high-volume or fast-paced environments.

  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and Italian.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to read metrics, spot patterns, and turn insights into action.

  • Excellent people skills: you genuinely enjoy engaging with customers and colleagues from diverse backgrounds, and you go the extra mile to create memorable experiences.

  • Comfort working across multiple tools, topics, and roles simultaneously — multitasking comes naturally to you.

  • Studying for or holding a professional degree in any field.

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in more than one additional language from the list above.

  • Experience with knowledge base management or training coordination.

  • Familiarity with CX platforms, ticketing tools, or support metrics dashboards.

Location for this Opportunity

Bogotá, Colombia.

This is a fully on-site role based at our Bogotá office.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage — Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

🎥 youtube.com/@building.nubank

🎧 Listen to our stories on Spotify

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the Role

  • Solve Ambiguous Problems: Lead deep-dive analyses on complex business questions, synthesizing unstructured data into clear, executive-ready recommendations.

  • Analyze Market & Onchain Trends: Evaluate blockchain transactions, liquidity, token activity, and market shifts to uncover consumer behavior insights.

  • Drive Experimentation & Causal Analysis: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests with high statistical rigor—setting clear hypotheses, sample sizes, conversion goals, and risk guardrails.

  • Own Core Metrics & Dashboards: Serve as the single point of ownership for key metrics and maintain executive dashboards.

  • Build Financial & Strategic Models: Create quantitative models, scenario analyses, and market sizing to evaluate new product features and international growth.

  • Develop Clean Data Pipelines: Write efficient SQL and Python code to extract, transform, and structure complex datasets, establishing reliable ETL workflows.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tooling: Responsibly integrate AI copilots and automated workflows into daily analytics to increase speed and decision quality.

  • Align Cross-Functional Partners: Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance to assess the commercial and operational impact of regulatory updates and business strategy.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Capacity & Rigor: Strong foundation in quantitative analysis, probability, statistical modeling, and financial mechanics applied to complex business problems.

  • Digital Assets Knowledge: Solid understanding of bitcoin, ethereum, blockchain protocols, crypto market dynamics, stablecoins, staking mechanics, and global exchange ecosystems.

  • Experimentation & Causal Inference: Hands-on experience designing controlled A/B tests, measuring statistical significance, and establishing guardrail metrics.

  • Technical & Tooling Proficiency: Advanced SQL and Python skills for data extraction, manipulation, and pipeline development.

  • Product & Strategic Thinking: Experience working alongside product managers and engineers in an iterative, fast-paced product development environment.

Executive Communication: Proven ability to translate complex quantitative findings into concise, compelling data stories that influence stakeholders.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

*Level: This is an IC role, without people management. A Senior Expert is equivalent to a Senior Manager role in a individual contributor path.

This is a unique opportunity to be the first dedicated, locally based People & Culture professional for Nu in the United States. Based in Miami, you will be the senior people partner for our US leadership and teams, building the P&C foundation from the ground up while partnering closely with our global P&C Centers of Excellence, Legal, Risk, and People Operations.

You will operate with exceptional autonomy in a structure that is still being built: setting up US people practices, ensuring compliance with US federal and state employment regulations, and shaping the organization, talent, and culture of a new market for Nu. This is a high-ownership, high-pace role for someone who enjoys building, wants real executive exposure, and is energized by ambiguity.

You'll be responsible for

  • Be the strategic partner to US leadership: act as a trusted advisor to the US executive team, co-creating the people and organizational strategy that will support the business's expansion in the country.

  • Build the US P&C foundation: support designing and implementing locally compliant people practices and policies (e.g., handbook, onboarding, leave, benefits, performance, compensation, and offboarding), adapting Nu's global frameworks to the US context and setting the standard for future scale.

  • Own US employment compliance and risk: anticipate federal, state, and local regulatory changes and build proactive compliance frameworks, partnering with Legal, Risk, and external counsel to ensure decisions are legally sound, business-aligned, and consistent across borders.

  • Lead org design and workforce planning: diagnose organizational needs and design the operating model, structures, and roles required to scale the US business; translate business plans into hiring, capability, and succession plans.

  • Partner on talent acquisition and US market insight: work with Talent Acquisition to define hiring strategies for a new market, bringing a strong read on the US labor market, talent pools, and competitive compensation practices in tech and financial services.

  • Drive the full talent cycle: coach leaders on performance management, compensation, leadership development, engagement, and career growth, ensuring Nu's global cycles work well locally.

  • Handle employee relations end-to-end: advise leaders on complex employee relations matters, conduct or oversee investigations, and manage terminations and sensitive cases in line with US law and Nu's values.

  • Lead change and shape culture: lead large-scale change initiatives (new teams, launches, restructures) and embed Nu's culture in a new location as the team grows.

  • Make decisions with data: use people analytics to anticipate risks, inform decisions, and translate insights into clear levers for leaders.

  • Coordinate the local ecosystem: work with vendors and partners (e.g., payroll, benefits brokers, PEO/EOR, immigration and employment counsel) and help evolve the local operating model as the presence matures.

  • Raise the bar for P&C: share US expertise with the global HRBP community and help shape how Nu scales people practices in new markets.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Extensive experience in HR Business Partnering or broader P&C leadership roles, with substantial experience supporting US-based teams and executives.

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of US employment law and regulations and multi-state employment considerations, plus familiarity with US benefits and leave practices.

  • Strong understanding of the US labor market, including talent dynamics and compensation practices in tech and/or financial services.

  • Track record in tech or high-growth companies, ideally having supported market entry, a new office or entity setup, or rapid expansion cycles.

  • Executive presence: proven ability to act as a trusted advisor to C-level and senior leaders, influence decisions, and challenge the status quo with credibility.

  • Experience designing operating models and leading organizational change at scale, from diagnosis to implementation.

  • A builder's mindset: comfortable creating structure where there is none, prioritizing in ambiguity, and moving from strategy to hands-on execution.

  • Ability to sustain a high workload and fast pace, including collaborating across time zones with teams in Latin America.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using data to frame business problems and drive fact-based decisions.

  • Excellent negotiation, conflict-management, and employee relations skills, with sound judgment on sensitive matters.

  • Full professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in regulated financial services (banking, fintech, broker-dealers) in the US.

  • Experience as the first or sole HR professional in a new country, entity, or office.

  • Experience with immigration and global mobility processes (e.g., H-1B, L-1, O-1) and international transfers.

  • Portuguese and/or Spanish proficiency.

  • SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent certification.

Location for this opportunity

  • Miami, United States

Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.
