About the role:

Growth MX squad aims to drive sustainable customer growth in Mexico by improving how people discover, join, activate and stay engaged with Nubank, while supporting multiple products, teams and channels simultaneously. We are looking for a researcher who can understand the customer journey end to end and turn insights into growth strategy, while setting a high bar for research quality within the squad. This person will lead the research agenda across acquisition, onboarding, activation and retention, and will partner closely with Product, Design, Data and Business.

You will be responsible for:

We are looking for an Senior Researcher with a strong background in UXR and mixed methods, capable of combining strategic vision, methodological rigor, AI usage and business partnership to uncover what drives customer growth in Mexico and consistently scale the impact of research.

  • Lead end-to-end research for Growth MX, turning open business questions into clear research plans across qual, quant and mixed methods.

  • Uncover why customers do or don’t sign up, activate, engage and stay, and translate findings into hypotheses and experiments.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Data and Business so insights shape the growth roadmap and what we build, test and scale.

  • Ensure research quality: rigorous methods, reusable insights and clear storytelling that influence senior stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar for the research practice, mentoring teammates and leveraging AI to scale how we generate and share insights.

Benefits:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Child care allowance

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 15 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership


Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of ​​expertise. For every eight or two weeks of remote work, one will be at the office.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the team

At Nu, Compliance is a strategic partner—not a tollgate. We view effective Risk Management & Compliance as the engine that maintains agility and empowers rapid, responsible growth across multiple global markets. Our team partners directly with internal clients using a targeted friction approach: we focus on the most relevant regulatory risks and embed compliance directly into product design rather than distributing rules after the fact.

The Global Compliance function serves as the Second Line of Defense, responsible for the full regulatory lifecycle: tracking new regulations, advising product and technology teams, testing controls, coordinating regulatory inspections, and monitoring remediation of regulatory issues.

This role is positioned at a pivotal moment. Nu has received conditional approval for a US National Bank Charter. Reporting to the Head of US Compliance, this individual contributor will independently assess complex regulatory questions, influence product and operational decisions, and lead compliance reviews from planning through reporting and remediation validation. The role also contributes to policy development, compliance risk reporting, and advice on regulatory issues.

Success requires strong regulatory judgment, practical experience evaluating controls, and the ability to turn complex requirements and findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You should be comfortable establishing processes, managing competing priorities, and driving work to completion in an evolving business.The role requires someone who can build from scratch, own outcomes, and operate with an entrepreneurial mindset in a highly regulated environment.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced consumer compliance professional to lead product compliance advisory engagements and internal compliance testing and monitoring across Nu’s US consumer banking products, including deposits, credit cards, and personal loans.

Reporting to the US Head of Compliance, this manager-level individual contributor will independently assess complex regulatory questions, influence product and operational decisions, and lead compliance reviews from planning through reporting and remediation validation. The role also contributes to policy development, compliance risk reporting, and advice on regulatory issues.

Success requires strong regulatory judgment, practical experience evaluating controls, and the ability to turn complex requirements and findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You should be comfortable establishing processes, managing competing priorities, and driving work to completion in an evolving business.

What you will do

Product Compliance Advisory

  • Serve as a primary compliance advisor to Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and other business teams throughout the product lifecycle, from initial design and launch through servicing.

  • Independently interpret applicable federal and state consumer financial protection requirements and translate them into practical product requirements, controls, and business guidance.

  • Review proposed products, features, customer journeys, disclosures, marketing materials, and operational processes to identify compliance risks and recommend workable solutions.

  • Assess the compliance implications of product and process changes, documenting advice, material risks, and matters requiring escalation.

  • Provide effective challenge to business decisions and control designs, working with stakeholders to resolve concerns and escalating material or unresolved risks.

  • Evaluate relevant regulatory developments and enforcement trends and advise business partners on necessary changes.

Compliance Testing & Monitoring

  • Develop and execute risk-based compliance testing and monitoring coverage, prioritizing products, processes, and controls based on regulatory obligations, customer impact, and emerging risks.

  • Lead reviews from scoping through completion, including defining objectives, developing test procedures, selecting samples, evaluating evidence, and documenting conclusions.

  • Assess whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively, including whether customer outcomes and business practices meet applicable requirements.

  • Produce clear, well-supported findings and reports that explain the regulatory concern, supporting evidence, customer impact, and recommended corrective action.

  • Establish and maintain monitoring indicators that help identify compliance weaknesses, recurring exceptions, and changes in risk.

  • Evaluate remediation plans, track corrective actions, and validate that completed remediation addresses identified issues.

Policy, Risk Reporting & Issue Advisory

  • Draft and update consumer compliance policies and standards, and advise business owners on related procedures.

  • Contribute to compliance risk assessments and management reporting, communicating significant findings, trends, and unresolved exposures.

  • Advise on issue assessment, root cause analysis, customer impact, and corrective action, with business owners accountable for implementing remediation.

What we are looking for

Required

  • Substantial experience in US consumer compliance at a bank, financial institution, or fintech, with demonstrated responsibility for both product advisory and compliance testing or monitoring.

  • Strong working knowledge of consumer financial protection requirements relevant to deposits and unsecured lending, including TILA/Regulation Z, ECOA/Regulation B, EFTA/Regulation E, TISA/Regulation DD, FCRA/Regulation V, and UDAAP.

  • Demonstrated ability to research and interpret regulatory requirements, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and develop defensible recommendations.

  • Hands-on experience designing and executing compliance reviews, evaluating controls, documenting findings, and validating remediation.

  • Ability to analyze operational and customer data to identify exceptions, assess customer impact, and support conclusions.

  • Strong writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex requirements and influence decisions across technical, business, and leadership audiences.

  • Proven ability to independently own significant workstreams, establish priorities, and escalate issues appropriately.

Preferred experience

  • Compliance advisory or testing across digital deposit, credit card, or personal loan products.

  • Experience with building compliance capabilities for a new or growing bank or fintech.

  • Experience using data analytics or automation to improve compliance monitoring and testing.

  • CRCM preferred, but not required.

 

Work Setup

Location

Miami, Florida

Work model

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Location: Bogotá, Colombia

The mission of the Regulatory Solutions team is to support Nu Colombia’s sustainable growth by ensuring that AML, ACF (Anti-Corruption), Garnishments, and other regulatory routines comply with both local and international requirements. We challenge the status quo through:

  • Promoting Excellence: Ensuring high standards of customer data quality and regulatory adherence to provide a best-in-class experience.

  • Operational Execution: Managing end-to-end AML routines, including KYC, PEP, Local Lists, Negative Media, Sanctions, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Transactional Monitoring, Garnishments, and SAC (Customer Support) inquiries.

  • Upholding Principles: Acting with diligence, flexibility, and resilience in alignment with our corporate values.

To achieve these goals, the AML & KYC Ops team is responsible for safeguarding the institution against illicit activities related to Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (ML/TF).


You'll be responsible for

The Analyst role involves the following core functions within the AML and KYC workflows:

  • Transactional Monitoring: Analyze alerts generated by the transactional monitoring system to identify ML/TF risk patterns that may require filing a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR/ROS) with the UIAF.

  • Network Analysis: Identify high-risk networks and escalate cases involving high technical or regulatory complexity.

  • Screening (Lists & Media): Execute and analyze screening results against Local Lists, Targeted Financial Sanctions, PEP, and Negative News, performing intensified due diligence for identified matches.

  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Conduct in-depth investigations for high-risk clients, including the validation of economic activity, Source of Funds (SoF) and Source of Wealth (SoW) to ensure comprehensive customer knowledge.

  • FATCA/CRS: Execute end-to-end FATCA and CRS due diligence, including the classification of individual and entity accounts, validation of self-certifications, and the identification of reportable accounts to ensure global tax transparency.

  • Operational Strengthening: Contribute to team alignment with the financial institution’s responsibilities and support the implementation of process improvements within KYC and AML workflows.

We are looking for a person who has

The ideal candidate for this position possesses:

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree.

  • Experience: At least 1 year of experience in transactional alert monitoring, KYC, PEP/Sanctions screening, or high-risk client analysis.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of local and international regulations applicable to KYC and transactional monitoring, following SARLAFT guidelines and expectations.

  • Technical Skills: Analytical capacity to manipulate data; familiarity with tools such as SQL or Scala is highly valued.

  • Decision-Making: Autonomy to make decisions that impact both the customer and the organization, based on established AML policies.

  • Languages: Fluency in Spanish and Upper-Intermediate English.

Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills and the ability to discuss complex cases with various stakeholders.

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Health and life insurance 

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Gym partnership

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

The Traffic Management team keeps Nubank’s customer‑facing and internal services reachable and secure. It is the layer that routes and protects every service request, from mobile app entry points to service‑to‑service calls across all our regions and environments. This function owns the strategy and execution for our service mesh ensuring our products can scale safely as we grow and expand. In this role, you will drive the reliability, scalability and security of this critical platform, evolving our service mesh, strengthening resilience and observability, and pushing our capabilities so that product teams can ship quickly without compromising stability.

You'll be responsible for

  • Deliver end‑to‑end milestones on the traffic platform, from problem definition to rollout and follow‑up, breaking complex problems into clear tasks and keeping progress and risks visible for the team and key stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of complex and sometimes ambiguous problems, analyzing options and trade‑offs, and proposing clear, pragmatic solutions that balance reliability, performance, security and effort.

  • Ensure the stability and quality of what you and the team ship: design with failure in mind, put the right tests and observability in place, and react quickly to incidents, driving follow‑ups that prevent them from happening again.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product and partner teams to understand needs, align on priorities and turn them into clear technical plans and milestones that are connected to the team’s goals.

  • Use AI and agents in an AI‑first way in your routine to investigate issues, write and review code, explore solution options and automate repetitive work, helping the squad adopt safe, effective AI workflows rather than just individual usage.

  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks that help other engineers understand, use and operate the traffic platform with confidence, and share knowledge through reviews, sessions and participation in function‑level initiatives.

  • Help other engineers grow by giving and receiving feedback through code reviews, design discussions, pairing and day‑to‑day collaboration, acting as a reference for good engineering practices inside the team.

  • Participate in support and on‑call routines for the area, using incidents, tickets and metrics as input to suggest and drive medium‑term improvements to the platform and to how we work.

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • Operated large-scale, high-performance synchronous distributed systems in the cloud, working directly with load balancers, reverse proxies, TLS/mTLS and routing, and using metrics, logs and traces to debug issues, optimize performance and improve overall reliability.

  • Worked hands-on with Kubernetes-based infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling — defining and evolving manifests, routing and deployment strategies, and managing DNS configuration — with a solid understanding of how these pieces fit together to deliver resilient traffic paths in production.

  • Uses AI as part of their daily engineering workflow, leveraging AI tools and agents to investigate issues, write and review code, explore solutions and automate repetitive work, while consistently validating outputs and holding quality and safety as non-negotiable standards.

  • Led end-to-end infrastructure platform projects from design to production go-live, breaking work into clear milestones, coordinating across stakeholders, managing risks and trade-offs, and following through post-rollout to stabilize and evolve the solution.

  • Experience with Istio or other service-mesh technologies such as Linkerd or Envoy-based solutions — or legacy stacks like Finagle — designing and evolving traffic policies, resilience features and observability for service-to-service communication.

  • Worked with AWS networking and compute primitives (ALB/NLB, security groups, VPC, Route 53, IAM) in production environments, with an understanding of how these layers interact with application traffic.

  • Hands-on experience using Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform to design, version and roll out changes to cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure in a safe, repeatable way.

  • Previously built platform capabilities or shared libraries for other engineers — abstractions, SDKs or internal tooling — that make it easier and safer for product teams to consume traffic and networking capabilities at scale.

 

Location

  • São Paulo - Brazil

  • Campinas - Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte - Brasil

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the Program

The Nu AI Core Summer Internship Program is a research-focused internship for PhD students working at the frontier of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Over about 12 weeks, interns collaborate with engineers, applied scientists, and researchers on complex AI challenges. Each intern leads an end-to-end research or applied AI project that combines research methods with large-scale production environments.

The program builds long-term relationships between industry and academia and with emerging AI research talent.


Program Structure

  • Duration: ~12 weeks

  • Start dates: May–June, aligned with US university calendars

  • Location model: Remote, with one in-person week at Nu's Palo Alto office in Silicon Valley, fully covered by us.

What you get

  • Dedicated research mentor

  • Ownership of a scoped AI research project

  • Access to large-scale datasets and compute infrastructure

  • Research talks and technical seminars

  • Final research presentation to leadership and AI teams

Research Areas

Interns may work on projects related to:

  • Machine learning and deep learning

  • Large language models and generative AI

  • Recommender systems and ranking models

  • AI infrastructure and model optimization

  • Responsible AI and model evaluation

Projects typically combine research experimentation with applied system development, including model design, experimentation, and large-scale evaluation.


Candidate Profile

This program targets PhD students conducting research in AI and machine learning who are interested in applying their work to real-world systems.

Applicants are typically pursuing a PhD in fields such as:

  • Computer Science

  • Machine Learning

  • Artificial Intelligence

  • Statistics

  • Mathematics

  • Computational Linguistics

  • Electrical Engineering

  • or related quantitative disciplines.


Basic Qualifications (Application/ Screening Filters)

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program

  • Research focus in machine learning, AI, statistics or related areas

  • Strong programming skills in Python or similar languages

  • Experience working with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)

  • Experience designing experiments and evaluating models

  • Experience working with large datasets or training ML models

Preferred Qualifications

Strong candidates may also demonstrate:

  • Publications at top AI/ML conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, KDD, RecSys, CVPR, CIKM or equivalent-conferences for related fields)

  • Experience working with large-scale ML systems or distributed training

  • Experience with LLMs, generative AI, or foundation models

  • Open-source contributions in AI or ML

  • Experience collaborating in interdisciplinary research environments


What We Value

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

  • Strong research rigor and experimental methodology

  • Ability to translate research ideas into practical systems

  • Track record of identifying novel research directions or reframing existing problems

  • Intellectual curiosity and independent problem solving

  • Collaboration with engineers and cross-functional teams

  • Interest in deploying AI systems with real-world impact

Benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account


Location for this opportunity

Remote, but only for USA PhD students

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Team

Nu's Business Control Officers (BCOs) are the first-line risk representatives embedded in each business unit. They make sure we understand the regulations we must follow, that controls are in place, and that our systems operate as intended across operational and regulatory risk.

As Nu grows, adds bank licenses and expands into new markets, first-line risk management has to scale with it. The global BCO team sets how the function works across the company, in close partnership with the second line, which defines the risk frameworks and verifies adherence to them.

About the Role

This role will redefine what a BCO is at Nu. You will move the function from coordination to leadership: setting the standards, methodologies and training that make first-line risk management consistent, high-quality and credible with regulators, across every market.

You will also own how Nu delivers cross-team regulatory change. As the company grows, many regulations touch several teams at once. You will establish clear ownership, escalation paths and a small delivery office that makes sure these commitments land on time.

You will:

  • Define the standards and methodologies for first-line risk management, and the role expectations for BCOs across business units

  • Partner with the second line to translate frameworks into clear, practical "how" standards that BUs can follow and be measured against

  • Own the model for delivering regulatory implementations that span multiple teams

  • Influence BU and market leaders so BCOs are empowered and effective in their markets

  • Build and lead a global team as the function scales

As a senior leadership role, this position is subject to Nu’s Global Statutory Officer Policy and involves appointment across applicable group entities. Final designation remains contingent upon local legal, compliance, and regulatory clearances.

Key Responsibilities and Expectations

Standards & Methodology

  • Establish common standards, templates and ways of working for first-line risk activities (e.g., risk assessments, control design and testing, issue management), replacing fragmented practices across BUs

  • Define the BCO role charter and what "good" looks like, and make it consistent across markets

  • Develop training and enablement so BCOs can deliver to that standard

  • Work with central tooling teams to measure quality and completeness of first-line execution

Regulatory Delivery

  • Design and run the decision framework that assigns ownership of regulations touching multiple teams, with clear escalation paths and timelines

  • Lead a risk office that tracks cross-team regulatory commitments through to delivery

  • Partner with Compliance and the second line so first-line standards keep pace with new regulations as we grow into new markets and licenses

Second-Line Partnership & Governance

  • Work with the second line so the first-line vs. second-line split is clear, and each line carries out its role

  • Translate regulatory expectations into clear first-line standards and controls that hold up under second-line review and regulatory scrutiny

Leadership & Influence

  • Partner with BU leaders, market leadership and BCOs (who report into their markets with a dotted line to this role)

  • Act as the senior voice on first-line risk management across the company

Qualifications

Professional Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc, JD) or professional certification preferred

  • 15+ years in risk management in regulated financial services, with substantial first-line or operational/regulatory risk experience

  • Experience in a regulated industry at scale (banking, large insurance, investment firms, regulated fintech)

  • Strong working knowledge of the first vs. second line model and of regulatory expectations for first-line risk management

  • Direct interaction with regulators (e.g., through examinations or MRA remediation) is a plus

  • Track record building risk and control frameworks, methodologies and standards, not only coordinating them

  • Command of operational risk, regulatory risk, control testing and issue management

  • Experience managing regulatory change that spans multiple teams

  • Experience in or with a high-growth, multi-market organization

Competencies & Attributes

  • Influencing senior leaders without direct authority

  • Comfort with ambiguity and redefining a function

  • Data-driven; able to define the metrics that show how well first-line risk management works

  • Strong communicator

US

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nu is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands-on experience in the domain produces.
Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.


What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.

  • Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement.

  • Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.

  • Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.

  • Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.

  • Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

  • Designing and facilitating large-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement.

  • Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization.

  • Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control.

 

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • Solid professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management.

  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid-course corrections.

  • Expert-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).

  • Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production-quality code in at least one general-purpose programming language.

  • Demonstrated ability to model identity-related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions.

  • A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer.

  • Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non-technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak.

  • Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third-party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure.

  • Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

  • Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open-source tooling, or participation in standards bodies.

Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • Miami, United States

  • Palo Alto, United States

  • Washington DC, United States

    Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

  • Compensation range: 200 - 240k + RSUs

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As a Lead Security Engineer you will be a senior technical and risk reference who moves where the risk is, across TPRM, Security Awareness and Cyber Risk, rather than owning a single silo. You will assess security gaps across diverse technologies, third parties and business contexts, quantify what matters, and turn it into prioritized, actionable treatment plans that leadership can decide on.

You will build and evolve the policies, methodologies, platforms and automation behind these programs, and help the squad scale across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and other geos without scaling headcount linearly. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Procurement, Operations, Internal Communication, Risk teams and the business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, pragmatic technical specifications. This is a multidisciplinary and global role, working with teams primarily based in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and the United States.

You will be responsible for

  • Assess security gaps across business processes and technologies, enable effective risk treatment, and define remediation plans with clear owners and deadlines.

  • Work closely with ITSec, Risk, Procurement stakeholders to align on mitigation of identified risks and on risk acceptance decisions.

  • Lead the evolution of the TPRM program toward a risk-based, lifecycle model: onboarding, continuous monitoring, offboarding, and fourth-party visibility.

  • Define/review security requirements for third parties, including contractual security clauses and annexes, and guide business owners on their application.

  • Build and scale automation and AI-assisted assessment capabilities that reduce manual questionnaire effort and increase coverage.

  • Report third-party risk posture and trends to leadership and relevant committees.

  • Drive human risk programs through phishing simulations, training and communication and evaluate and evolve the tooling behind them (build versus buy).

  • Define and track behavior-change metrics that go beyond completion rates, and report them through dashboards for management.

  • Act as technical lead across the squad, raising the technical and analytical bar and fostering continuous improvement.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Proven experience designing and implementing security controls and leading risk management initiatives, with strong knowledge of domains and concepts of cyber risks.

  • Hands-on experience with risk analysis techniques: risk identification, assessment and prioritization, using both qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • Experience with TPRM (third-party risk management).

  • Experience building or running security awareness and human-risk programs, or a strong ability to ramp up on them quickly.

  • Experience with large-scale distributed environments and cloud environments (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO 27001/27002/27005, ISO 31000, PCI-DSS, ITIL, COBIT and similar.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, able to translate complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.

  • Technical background and comfort with automation, scripting and AI or LLM-based tooling to scale security processes.

  • Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.

  • Proven ability to lead projects and process improvement initiatives, and to mentor other engineers and analysts.

  • Advanced English proficiency, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Information Security, Risk Management or related fields.

  • Certifications such as PCI ISA or PCIP, CISA, CISM or CISSP.

  • Experience in a regulated fintech, financial services environment or consulting roles.

  • Experience with AI risk: assessing risks of generative AI and LLM use cases (data leakage, prompt injection, model and vendor risk)

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

About the role

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership. We collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, embedding security in business decisions so that Nubank can grow safely.

We make sure identified risks are mitigated and that leaders, inside and outside the IT and Security Business Unit, can make decisions based on risk. The focus of the security compliance squad is to ensure Nubank complies with regulations across countries and entities, and holds PCI DSS certifications, alongside other frameworks.

You will be responsible for

  • Provide operational support and act as a focal point for the assigned certification scope.

  • Interpret certification requirements applicable to your scope and execute and coordinate recurring tests required by the certification.

  • Register, manage, and track action plans arising from audit findings or identified gaps.

  • Maintain a day-to-day interface with audited and external teams on control implementation, scope alignment, evidence collection, and deadline agreement.

  • Propose and implement improvements in internal certification processes.

  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with product, engineering and IT teams to make audits and assessments smoother and less disruptive.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, IT and global teams to integrate compliance requirements into processes and systems.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Solid knowledge across cybersecurity domains and frameworks such as PCI DSS, SOC2, DORA, NIST and similar standards.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

*Level: This is an IC role, without people management. A Senior Expert is equivalent to a Senior Manager role in a individual contributor path.

Nu's Legal Team protects Nu's interests and reputation by supporting the launch and sustainable growth of products and services. Legal is a strategic partner to every area of Nu. It provides specialized legal analysis and proposes innovative solutions to the daily challenges of a constantly evolving digital environment, and it is committed to mitigating legal risk, anticipating issues and resolving disputes efficiently and fairly.

This is a senior position on our Global Strategic Contracts & Growth team, which supports strategic projects for Nu's global growth. You will report to the Legal Director who leads this team. Interest in contributing actively to Nu's products and business, and the ability to think innovatively and challenge the status quo, are essential.

We are looking for someone with M&A experience, particularly in the financial and technology sectors. You will lead the legal workstreams of these projects, including due diligence and negotiation of transaction documents, in close alignment with our Corporate Development team and external advisors. We anticipate transactions in different countries, so we want someone who can learn quickly and contribute to innovative projects.

The role also involves negotiating complex agreements (e.g., Banking-as-a-Service, payments, partnerships and negotiations with global vendors) and advising on tech and fintech products. We are looking for someone who is AI-forward and innovative, who uses AI tools to work faster and better, and who helps the team adopt new ways of working.

We are looking for a lawyer with experience in complex contracts, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to autonomously lead cross-functional projects on matters relevant to Nu's growth.

Our team culture promotes knowledge sharing, skills development and constant feedback, so we can keep improving and stay adaptable to changes in our methods and processes.

This position should be located in one of the existing Nu's offices, preferably in São Paulo, Palo Alto or Miami.

You will be responsible for

Legal support on M&A, strategic partnerships and global contracts, including:

  • M&A: leading Legal's work on M&A, including interactions with internal areas and outside counsel, coordinating legal due diligence, negotiating transaction agreements, supporting strategic discussions and measures to be implemented post-signing and post-closing.

  • Strategic contracts: reviewing, negotiating and drafting contracts with global suppliers and strategic partners, with a focus on tech and fintech agreements - think innovative products. You will negotiate directly with counterparties and contribute to strategy and business vision.

  • AI and innovation: Using and promoting AI tools in legal work (research, drafting, review) and helping the team become more efficient.

We are looking for someone who has

  • Law degree and active admission to the New York Bar (in good standing);

  • Experience in M&A, particularly in the financial and technology sectors (law firm or in-house);

  • Experience with fintech products and in negotiating tech and fintech agreements;

  • AI-forward and innovative mindset, with hands-on use of AI tools in legal work;

  • Objective communication and proactive stakeholder management;

  • Adaptability and fast learning;

  • Holistic thinking;

  • Proactive and curious attitude;

  • Ability to solve problems creatively;

  • Project management.

Nice to have:

  • Brazilian bar (OAB) membership;

  • Advanced Spanish.

Location for this opportunity

  • Miami, United States

Our benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations.

Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

What you'll work on

NuBrain — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

What you'll do

- Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones.

- Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.

- Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.

- Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

- Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.

- Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.

What we're looking for

An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer. This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges.

A track record architecting UX systems. Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

A love for design that shows up in your work. Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

Agentic systems that help design scale. Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role.

A protagonist. You'll serve a 260-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project.

Evidence you've shipped. Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio.

Backgrounds that tend to fit

- Design systems and UI platform engineers at design-led product companies.

- Engineers at design tooling companies.

- Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public.

- Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design-led product.

What this role is not

- Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar.

- Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core.

- Not customer-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function.

- Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.)

About the Role

You’ll be part of Nu’s global expansion one of the most exciting chapters in our story. As we enter new international markets, customer experience is our most powerful differentiator, and this role sits at the heart of it.

As a Customer Experience Analyst on our internationalization team, you’ll be a founding member of a CX operation built from scratch in a brand-new country. That means you’ll do more than handle customer interactions — you’ll help shape how we operate, train, and grow across borders. From delivering mind-blowingly great support to identifying process gaps and turning customer feedback into business insight, your work will directly influence what Nu looks like for customers in new markets around the world.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about people, and is excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up — with the full backing of a global platform behind them.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Deliver first and second level customer support across chat, email, back-office, and phone channels, consistently meeting CX metrics and ensuring an outstanding customer experience in all supported languages.

  • Manage the CX knowledge base and training processes to ensure team members are equipped to handle all case types — including complex and escalation-worthy situations — with confidence.

  • Monitor CX metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and design and implement action plans to continuously improve performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Alert relevant stakeholders to operational needs and opportunities, including headcount requirements, training gaps, and people-related inputs.

  • Coordinate local initiatives with broader organizational and cross-functional efforts involving the Xpeer team, including support for new international market launches.

  • Ensure all customer excellence processes are documented, accessible, and kept up to date at the squad level.

  • Switch seamlessly across support squads and roles as the team grows and evolves, bringing consistency and energy to each area.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in customer service or operations roles, ideally in high-volume or fast-paced environments.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team's challenge is to help Nubank make better financial decisions. Our mission is to understand the company's performance from a financial perspective by analyzing past results and creating future projections. Broadly, our team is subdivided into FP&A Horizontals, FP&A Markets, FP&A Global Products, FP&A Efficiency, and Procurement.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Analyzing, explaining, and projecting the financial aspects of products related to the Lending Business Unit.

  • Improving FP&A processes to generate insights and provide clarity in financial statements, always thinking in a scalable way and using reliable data.

  • Understanding and analyzing the impact of product-related decisions on a Business Unit's (BU) financial results.

  • Automating reports by connecting them to databases from different sources.

  • Building, updating, and reviewing financial models and simulators.

  • Preparing and presenting executive materials with financial results to the Business Unit and the Board of Directors.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Experience in financial forecasting and analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow).

  • Solid knowledge of financial modeling.

  • a strong analytical ability to manage and evaluate complex data.

  • Eager to learn and adapts easily to change.

  • Strong communication skills to proactively interact with various business partners and stakeholders (Product, Finance, Markets).

  • Advanced knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets.

  • Proficient in English.

  • Knowledge of programming languages (Scala, SQL, and Python) as a plus.

  • Preference for candidates with previous experience in Credit (other Banks or Fintechs.)

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Engineering at Nubank

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, that currently includes a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You can read more about it in our engineering blog and get some insights into how we work.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Lead a team of 8~10 software engineers (ICs)

  • Foster a culture of teamwork, feedback and continuous improvement

  • Conduct effective 1:1s, team meetings and rituals

  • Manage individual contributors, enabling them to be high performers and support others

  • Deliver distributed systems at scale

  • Align stakeholders around team’s vision, goals, and metrics

  • Reason about software architecture design decisions

  • Look and implement improvements in the way we work and organize

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Experience leading Engineering teams, ideally with a background as a software engineer or software architect

  • Experience being accountable for people management, having exposure to performance assessment, hiring, supporting career growth, etc

  • Experience leading agile teams, being familiar with the most relevant ceremonies, metrics and processes

  • A good level of technical understanding, being able to take part in architecture discussions with Engineers and to translate complex, technical projects and concepts for non-engineers.

  • Advanced level of English - you'll be part of a global team

 

Location

Mexico City, Mexico.

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

ORA (Office Risk Affairs) is the team that keeps the Global Credit Card BU’s operational risk landscape visible, monitored, and under control across credit, regulatory, and transactional domains. Our BAs don’t just monitor their own domains end-to-end: from KRI design to risk narrative to independent representation in ORA leadership forums. If you like turning complex risk signals into clear decisions that move real numbers, this is your seat


About the Role

  • Solve Ambiguous Problems: Lead deep-dive analyses on complex business questions, synthesizing unstructured data into clear, executive-ready recommendations.

  • Run impactful projects: 2-3 initiatives with ambiguous objectives and scope to be tackled with Engineering, Product, Controllership and BCOs (Business Control Officers).

  • Raise the bar on KRIs and controls: thresholds, signal logic, data quality and services interactions, all reviewed and connected to impact to escalate to leadership

  • Own Core Metrics & Dashboards: Serve as the single point of ownership for key metrics and maintain executive dashboards.

  • Shape how we use AI: build shared prompts, skills, automated routines or bots to make us faster without making us less right or critical.

  • Develop Clean Data Pipelines: Write efficient SQL and Python code to extract, transform, and structure complex datasets, establishing reliable ETL workflows.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tooling: Responsibly integrate AI copilots and automated workflows into daily analytics to increase speed and decision quality.

  • Align Cross-Functional Partners: Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance to assess the commercial and operational impact of regulatory updates and business strategy.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Capacity & Rigor: Strong foundation in quantitative analysis, probability, statistical modeling, and financial mechanics applied to complex business problems.

  • Experimentation & Causal Inference: Hands-on experience designing controlled A/B tests, measuring statistical significance, and establishing guardrail metrics.

  • Technical & Tooling Proficiency: Advanced SQL and Python skills for data extraction, manipulation, and pipeline development.

  • Product & Strategic Thinking: Experience working alongside product managers and engineers in an iterative, fast-paced product development environment.

Executive Communication: Proven ability to translate complex quantitative findings into concise, compelling data stories that influence stakeholders.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Deputy MLRO (AML Compliance)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.

We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).

You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

  • Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

  • Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

  • Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

  • Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

  • Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

  • Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

  • Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

  • As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

  • Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

  • Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

  • Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

  • Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

  • Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

  • Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

  • Has built or set up an AML function or framework

  • Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

  • Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

  • Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

  • Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

  • Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

  • Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

  • Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

  • Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

  • Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland (you must live in Switzerland today)

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the role
Money Boxes ("Caixinhas") is one of Nubank’s most strategic product innovations, transforming how millions of customers organize, save, and grow their money across Latin America. As Nubank expands into new geographies and financial verticals, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Software Engineer to serve as the chief technical authority for our Money Boxes core platform.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high-concurrency distributed systems, transactional ledgering, investment asset allocation, and liquidity orchestration. You won't just maintain existing product flows—you will architect the foundational engines that enable millions of users to dynamically deposit, segment, and yield return on their savings instantly, securely, and at massive scale.

Your Mission: scale an extensible, multi-tenant Money Boxes platform that abstracts complex investment assets, yield generation mechanisms, and regulatory ledgering into simple, bulletproof platform capabilities across multiple international markets.

What You Will Own & Build

  • Money Boxes Platform Architecture: Define and execute the multi-year technical vision for Money Boxes backend architecture, ensuring high extensibility to support diverse underlying assets (e.g., fixed income, yield-bearing accounts, money market funds) across different countries.

  • Core Ledgering & Transaction Engines: Architect high-throughput, double-entry accounting engines and balance tracking systems that guarantee exact-once delivery, deterministic reconciliation, and real-time calculation of accruals and yield.

  • Liquidity & Asset Routing Infrastructure: Design resilient execution flows for deposits, withdrawals, and auto-investments, managing real-time settlement with internal brokerages, clearinghouses, and banking rails with low latencies and zero transactional error margin.

  • Multi-Country & Multi-Currency Abstractions: Abstract regional regulatory rules, local tax logic, and currency nuances into clean platform boundaries so product squads can launch localized Money Boxes experiences in record time.

  • Technical RFC Leadership: Author comprehensive design documents (RFCs) and drive architectural consensus across Payments, Core Banking, Investments, and Security leadership.

  • Engineering Mentorship & Technical Rigor: Elevate engineering standards across Money Boxes squads by mentoring senior engineers in distributed systems design, resilience patterns, fault tolerance, and domain-driven design.

What We Are Looking For

  • Senior IC Track Record: Proven experience as a senior technical leader (Staff/Senior Staff level) designing, operating, and scaling highly available, mission-critical distributed systems.

  • Fintech, Banking, or Investments Domain Depth: Deep hands-on experience building systems in transactional environments—such as savings platforms, ledger/accounting engines, investment order management, custody, or core banking infrastructure.

  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Exceptional fluency in event-driven architectures, transactional consistency, distributed sagas, domain-driven design (DDD), and high-concurrency microservices.

  • Platform & API Mindset: Demonstrated ability to build domain-agnostic, developer-friendly platforms and APIs with explicit contracts, SLAs, and high observability that allow consuming product teams to innovate rapidly.

  • Strategic & Horizontal Influence: Proven success driving cross-organizational technical alignment, navigating architectural trade-offs, and communicating technical strategy clearly to engineering leaders, Product Managers, and General Managers.

  • Language & Location: Professional fluency in English is required for international collaboration. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Roles are open in Brazil (hybrid model) or key US hubs..

Why Join Us?

You will join a high-bar engineering culture that values architectural clarity, technical depth, and rapid execution speed. You will directly own the systems that help over 140 million people build financial security and grow their wealth—shaping the future of personal finance technology across global markets.
