About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

We are seeking an FP&A Senior Specialist to be the finance partner for our Digital Assets organization. Today that means our crypto trading and custody business in Brazil and the digital asset products inside Nu Global, including stablecoin balances, cross-border money movement, and crypto trading. As Nubank and the Digital Assets business expands to additional geographies, you will own the finance view of this business in each market it enters.

Digital Assets is both a customer product and a set of rails. Stablecoins, FX, on and off ramps, and card spending can be a source of revenue, a cost to manage, or the reason a customer chooses us in the first place. This role is about building as the business grows, including how we model and forecast it, starting with the economics of a single customer, trade, or balance and building up to the business P&L. You will also own the position Finance takes on those numbers with Digital Assets leadership.

The scope covers every digital asset product we offer, in every market where we offer it. Economics and accounting differ by product, entity, and country, and many of the answers are still being worked out. You will decide which assumptions matter most, make them explicit, and revise them as the business learns.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and regular exposure to the leaders who run these businesses. You will be expected to hold a position when the analysis supports it, push back with evidence, and take direct feedback. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will stay hands-on in the models and analysis, and you will help raise the standard of work across the FP&A team around you.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Own the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles for Digital Assets across Brazil and Nu Global, with accountability for the integrity of the numbers and for the position Finance takes on them with leadership.

  • Build the P&L for each digital asset product, from trading and swaps to custody and stablecoin yield, and model how volume, take rate, balances, pricing, and partner costs flow through to Nubank's consolidated results.

  • Track gross profit and cost-to-serve, including execution and liquidity costs, custody and platform provider fees, payment network and funding costs, and regulatory and audit requirements, and bring a point of view on what should change when results move.

  • Support expansion into new geographies with the financial analysis behind each launch, including unit economics, local rails and funding methods, and the effect of licensing and legal entity structures.

  • Partner with Controllership, Treasury, Legal, and Risk on custody accounting, reconciliation, yield accrual, and liquidity planning as assets under custody and stablecoin balances scale.

  • Work with Digital Assets product and business leaders early enough to shape pricing, product, and investment decisions.

  • Prepare clear, concise executive materials that simplify complex topics, often on short timelines.

  • Use AI, advanced analytics, and automation to speed up planning and analysis, while keeping the judgment to review and challenge AI-generated output.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • You can build the P&L for a trading, custody, payments, or banking product from a blank page, understand how the lines interact, and find what is wrong in a model built by someone else or by an AI tool.

  • You understand how money movement and digital assets make and cost money, including trading and liquidity, custody, stablecoins and yield, FX, and card and payment networks, or you have the curiosity and rigor to get there quickly.

  • You are comfortable starting from incomplete information, making assumptions explicit, and building planning processes where none exist yet.

  • You present with clarity to senior stakeholders, hold your ground on substance, and adapt when new information changes the answer.

  • You build trust with product, controllership, treasury, legal, and risk partners, and you influence decisions without formal authority.

  • You use modern analytics and AI tools to raise the speed and quality of your work, and you know where their output needs a human check. SQL and data skills are a plus.

  • You share what you know, give and take direct feedback, and help raise the bar for the analysts around you.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Business, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certification (e.g., CFA) is a plus.

  • Experience with crypto, stablecoins, FX, or cross-border payments.

  • Experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate development, or business analysis, ideally in financial services, such as a bank, brokerage, exchange, card issuer, payments or remittance company, or fintech.

  • Track record of building P&Ls and forecasting models for financial products, not only maintaining them.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

The Traffic Management team keeps Nubank’s customer‑facing and internal services reachable and secure. It is the layer that routes and protects every service request, from mobile app entry points to service‑to‑service calls across all our regions and environments. This function owns the strategy and execution for our service mesh ensuring our products can scale safely as we grow and expand. In this role, you will drive the reliability, scalability and security of this critical platform, evolving our service mesh, strengthening resilience and observability, and pushing our capabilities so that product teams can ship quickly without compromising stability.

You'll be responsible for

  • Deliver end‑to‑end milestones on the traffic platform, from problem definition to rollout and follow‑up, breaking complex problems into clear tasks and keeping progress and risks visible for the team and key stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of complex and sometimes ambiguous problems, analyzing options and trade‑offs, and proposing clear, pragmatic solutions that balance reliability, performance, security and effort.

  • Ensure the stability and quality of what you and the team ship: design with failure in mind, put the right tests and observability in place, and react quickly to incidents, driving follow‑ups that prevent them from happening again.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product and partner teams to understand needs, align on priorities and turn them into clear technical plans and milestones that are connected to the team’s goals.

  • Use AI and agents in an AI‑first way in your routine to investigate issues, write and review code, explore solution options and automate repetitive work, helping the squad adopt safe, effective AI workflows rather than just individual usage.

  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks that help other engineers understand, use and operate the traffic platform with confidence, and share knowledge through reviews, sessions and participation in function‑level initiatives.

  • Help other engineers grow by giving and receiving feedback through code reviews, design discussions, pairing and day‑to‑day collaboration, acting as a reference for good engineering practices inside the team.

  • Participate in support and on‑call routines for the area, using incidents, tickets and metrics as input to suggest and drive medium‑term improvements to the platform and to how we work.

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • Operated large-scale, high-performance synchronous distributed systems in the cloud, working directly with load balancers, reverse proxies, TLS/mTLS and routing, and using metrics, logs and traces to debug issues, optimize performance and improve overall reliability.

  • Worked hands-on with Kubernetes-based infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling — defining and evolving manifests, routing and deployment strategies, and managing DNS configuration — with a solid understanding of how these pieces fit together to deliver resilient traffic paths in production.

  • Uses AI as part of their daily engineering workflow, leveraging AI tools and agents to investigate issues, write and review code, explore solutions and automate repetitive work, while consistently validating outputs and holding quality and safety as non-negotiable standards.

  • Led end-to-end infrastructure platform projects from design to production go-live, breaking work into clear milestones, coordinating across stakeholders, managing risks and trade-offs, and following through post-rollout to stabilize and evolve the solution.

  • Experience with Istio or other service-mesh technologies such as Linkerd or Envoy-based solutions — or legacy stacks like Finagle — designing and evolving traffic policies, resilience features and observability for service-to-service communication.

  • Worked with AWS networking and compute primitives (ALB/NLB, security groups, VPC, Route 53, IAM) in production environments, with an understanding of how these layers interact with application traffic.

  • Hands-on experience using Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform to design, version and roll out changes to cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure in a safe, repeatable way.

  • Previously built platform capabilities or shared libraries for other engineers — abstractions, SDKs or internal tooling — that make it easier and safer for product teams to consume traffic and networking capabilities at scale.

 

Location

  • Toronto - Canada

Our Benefits

  • Health Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Pension Plan

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Vacations

  • Compensation range 156k - 184k

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Ensure the sustainable Nubank's growth supporting the regulatory demands of AML Ops operations routines, challenging the status quo through:

  • The best experience to our fanatics and loved clients in the AML Ops process, keeping the highest level of quality for customer data and due diligence applicable accordingly to the regulators and internal policies;

  • Analyzing the transactional AML Alerts generated by the AML transaction monitoring system, to identify suspicious situations, contributing to a more ethical and fair society, truly understanding that it is also a key driving force for the solid growth and development of Nubank and Brazil & Mexico;

Being diligent, flexible and resilient, according to Nu's principles!

In order to achieve that, our Operational Squad - AML Ops - is responsible for protecting Nu against criminal activities and helping stop the laundering of ‘dirty’ money into the Mexican economy, complying with the necessary regulations, and ensuring the continuity of our business.


What does a Regulatory Solutions analyst for AML Ops do…

  • Analyze AML Alerts, financial transactions, accounts, and data from the alerts generated by the AML transaction monitoring system, to identify suspicious situations and provide detailed recommendations (Report to UIF, Cancel, etc.)

  • Prepare all the investigation files to escalate it to the AML Forum (Comité de Comunicación y Control).

  • Strengthen the AML Ops team to be aligned with the responsibilities we have as a financial institution.

  • Sophisticated reporting to immediately inform money-laundering or terrorism financing activity to the relevant authorities (SHCP, CNBV, UIF, etc.).

  • Perform quality reviews, evaluate process deficiencies, analyze control measures, enhance reporting capabilities and recommend corrective actions while satisfying regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct thorough investigations in order to detect risky customers by evaluating the customers’ risk profiles and processing them accordingly (enhanced due diligence, customer due diligence, etc.).

  • Provide advice on sanctions and other screening processes such as KYC. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional areas (including legal, compliance, and risk management, among others)  to minimize money-laundering risks to the business

  • Support the discard operation in binding lists.

  • Apply FIU typologies.

  • Involvement in the implementation of the regulatory framework that will contribute to Nu Mexico's growth plan.

  • Stay current with AML/FT laws, regulations, and industry standards to ensure our practices remain compliant.

Qualifications:

  • You are detail-oriented, diligent, organized and enjoy operational activities. 

  • You have excellent reporting skills, particularly for regulatory reporting.

  • You are a proactive, autonomous person and have an interest in owning your operational routines and creating processes and improving them, but at the same time, understand that there are bureaucracies in the regulatory activities that need to be followed. 

  • You are able to meet deadlines and to be flexible to adapt to changing conditions.

  • You can communicate clearly, succinctly and effectively. 

  • You feel good to be constantly challenged to learn and do more. 

  • You are good with oral and written communication in Spanish and/or English. 

  • You believe in a more just and ethical society and Nubank's values ​​and culture.

  • You have a strong sense of integrity and responsibility handling sensitive information.

  • You understand that we can contribute within Nubank to the construction of this society, guaranteeing the application of all the rules and regulatory aspects inherent to the Client's Registration.

  • You can easily turn numbers into complex strategies, proposals and effective action plans.

It will be a differential if you..

  • Have a Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Administration, Finance, Economic Sciences  or related;

  • Have CNBV certification is a plus, or strong experience in AML Regulations;

  • Have previous experience in monitoring transactional AML alerts for the different banking products (Credit Card, Savings, Remittances, Investments, etc.) and-or in compliance areas in processes related to AML;

  • Have knowledge of sanctions and KYC processes related to AML;

  • Have knowledge in sending the suspicious activity reports (SAR, ROI);

  • Have autonomy to make decisions that impact customers and Nu based on AML policies;

  • Know the specific regulations of the area and have the responsibility to apply them in their routine;

  • Have curiosity and willingness to learn;

  • Have knowledge in Excel, Sheets, Looker, SQL and Python;

  • Have Banking & Sofipo regulation knowledge;

  • Have knowledge in CNBV regulation, freezing, unfreezing and transfer money;

Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Health and life insurance 

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Onsite position - 5 days perweek

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Senior Counsel, Regulatory Legal – Latin America (Payments & Digital Assets)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

As Senior Counsel, Regulatory Legal – Latin America, you will be the legal voice on how Nu's payments and digital-assets products can operate, launch and scale across the region. You will define where licenses, registrations or regulated entities are required, and turn that analysis into a clear recommendation the business can act on.

This is a legal and regulatory strategy role, not a compliance operations role. You will work with Product, Compliance, Public Policy, Risk, Treasury and business leaders on new products and new markets, in an environment where regulation is moving faster than the product. You will own the regulatory path for what we build next, and you will be expected to say "here is the path I recommend", not just "here are the risks".

You'll be responsible for

  • Advising on regulatory legal strategy for payments, money movement, wallets, stored value, digital assets, stablecoins and related products across Latin America.

  • Building and maintaining a country-by-country view of the regulatory perimeter: which activities require licenses, registrations, approvals or local regulated entities.

  • Leading the legal analysis for entry into new markets and for the launch of new products, features and business models.

  • Working with Product and business teams to structure products in line with applicable law, and proposing alternative structures when the initial model hits a regulatory obstacle.

  • Coordinating license and registration applications (payments, financial services, virtual assets) and supporting engagement with regulators, central banks and other authorities, including on novel issues.

  • Managing local external counsel while remaining accountable for synthesizing their input into a practical recommendation.

  • Creating scalable frameworks, playbooks and decision trees so recurring questions are answered consistently across markets.

  • Monitoring regulatory developments and separating what materially affects our strategy from general noise, and anticipating where regulation is heading on stablecoins, tokenized money, crypto-assets and new payment infrastructure.

  • Briefing senior legal and business leaders on complex regulatory topics in clear, concise and commercially useful terms.

  • Acting as a generalist legal business partner for new businesses in Latin America, coordinating a holistic legal approach, including support on agreements related to our products.

We are looking for someone who has

  • Qualified as a lawyer, holding the local bar license in the country where you will be based.

  • In-house experience at a fintech, payments, crypto/digital-assets or banking company, where you personally worked through regulatory, licensing and market-entry questions in Latin America.

  • Hands-on experience with payments regulation and licensing, and with digital assets, crypto, stablecoins or blockchain-based financial products.

  • Experience analyzing and comparing regulatory regimes across several Latin American jurisdictions, not a single-country specialty, with familiarity with the South American regulatory landscape.

  • A solid understanding of how payments, banking, securities, FX and digital-asset regulation interact.

  • Experience taking part in obtaining or maintaining financial-services, payments or digital-asset licenses or registrations.

  • Experience breaking down complex product architectures and money flows to pinpoint the core regulatory question, and the judgment built along the way to know when to escalate, bring in external counsel or engage a regulator, and when the business can simply move forward.

  • A track record of briefing senior legal and business leaders on technical regulatory topics, turning them into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Experience as a senior, autonomous legal partner to Product and business teams in fast-moving environments, owning ambiguous problems and finding a compliant path forward instead of only flagging risks.

  • Fluent English and Spanish.

Nice to have

  • Direct work with financial regulators or central banks, or prior experience at a financial-regulatory law firm, central bank or regulator.

  • Experience in regulatory policy for digital assets and payments.

  • Banking or credit regulatory background combined with curiosity about digital assets.

  • Familiarity with additional Latin American markets.

Location for this opportunity

  • Buenos Aires, Argentina

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Bogotá, Colombia

Our Benefits

Brazil

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nubank is scaling rapidly across Latin America, and our Mexico division is central to empowering millions of people with intuitive, transparent, and accessible financial services. To support our sustained customer growth and expand our product ecosystem reliably, we need senior technical leaders who can translate high-level business vision into resilient, scalable distributed architectures.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical anchor across the Mexico division, collaborating closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams spanning Growth, Operations, and Core Value Proposition. You will bridge local market dynamics with Nubank's global platform ecosystem, steering architectural decisions that directly impact how prospects seamlessly transition into engaged Nubank customers.

Operating with a country-wide horizontal perspective, you will guide technical roadmaps across multiple business units and squads, untangle complex domain boundaries, and elevate engineering standards across chapters. By pairing architectural vision with pragmatic delivery, you will ensure our systems remain resilient, extensible, and prepared for exponential scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for the Mexico division using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to decouple complex systems and eliminate single points of failure.

  • Steer technical strategy across squads in Growth, Operations, and Core Value Prop, ensuring local business flows integrate seamlessly with Nubank’s global platform foundation.

  • Mentor and develop senior engineering talent across chapters, cultivating technical excellence, architectural rigor, and operational best practices.

  • Partner with engineering directors and executive leadership to translate commercial objectives into scalable system designs and actionable execution roadmaps.

  • Drive cross-team technical consensus on mission-critical initiatives, advocating for sound trade-offs between delivery velocity and platform extensibility.

  • Champion operational resilience and observability across customer acquisition funnels, proactively identifying bottlenecks to optimize conversion latency and system reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of technical leadership as a Staff-level engineer (or equivalent scope) guiding distributed systems architecture across multi-team engineering organizations.

  • Deep practical expertise applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to design, decouple, and scale event-driven microservices.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional technical roadmaps across globally distributed platform and product teams without direct hierarchical authority.

  • Experience architecting mission-critical, high-throughput systems where fault tolerance, reliability, and low-latency performance are essential.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, with demonstrated success communicating complex architectural concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish or prior engineering experience building digital products tailored for the Latin American market (specifically Mexico).

  • Background designing high-conversion growth, onboarding, or acquisition engines within large-scale consumer technology or high-growth fintech environments.

  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud-native ecosystems, functional programming paradigms (e.g., Clojure, Scala), or distributed event streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

  • Track record of building and scaling systems at top-tier global technology companies.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in Buenos Aires, Argentina on a Hybrid model at our Buenos Aires office. Work model: Hybrid,3 times per week.

Willingness and ability to travel to our Mexico City office approximately once per quarter for cross-team planning and collaboration.

Diversity & Inclusion / Equal Opportunity

At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For information on how we process your personal data throughout the recruitment process, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice on our careers page.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Head of Design, Global App Platforms (Core)

ABOUT THE ROLE

Core is the team that defines what great design means at Nu. It's a small, deliberately elite group of designers with two jobs: set the bar for design across the company today, and decide where that bar is headed next.

Core delivers the vision for the Nu app as it launches across countries. Right now that means designing the next version of the app, and the version after that. But vision alone isn't the job. Everything Core builds has to be adoptable by every market. When Core ships a new experience, it defines the guidelines, hands them to our teams in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, and partners with them as they tailor it to their customers.

As Senior Design Manager, you'll lead this team. It's a high-craft environment made up of some of the strongest individual contributors in the company, many of them from the most design-led companies in tech. You'll be hands-on in the work while giving the team the structure, focus, and air cover it needs to do the best work of their careers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Set the Bar: Define and raise the standard for design quality across Nu, and make that standard legible enough that every team can work toward it.

  • Lead the Next Generation of the App: Shape the vision and execution for the next versions of the Nu app, from early concepts through launch-ready guidelines.

  • Stay Hands-On: Get into the work with your team. Critique, prototype, push the craft, and help solve the hardest design problems directly.

  • Build for Adoption: Make sure everything Core creates can scale across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Partner with local teams so global guidelines become experiences that fit each market's customers.

  • Partner Across Design: Work closely with the Design System team and other design leaders so Core's vision and the system that delivers it move together.

  • Lead and Grow a World-Class Team: Manage a small team of senior, high-craft designers. Give them clarity, protect their focus, and help them grow.

  • Manage Stakeholders: Represent Core's work to product, engineering, and business leaders, align them on direction, and remove the blockers that slow great work down.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • Exceptional Craft: A portfolio that shows world-class product and visual design, with consumer, mobile-first work at scale.

  • Vision You've Shipped: Experience defining the future direction of a product and seeing that vision through to launch.

  • Hands-On Leadership: You lead from inside the work. Formal people-management experience is a plus, not a requirement; we care more that you've raised the bar for the designers around you.

  • Stakeholder Management: A track record of influencing senior cross-functional partners and driving alignment across teams that don't report to you. This isn't a lone-wolf role.

  • Systems Thinking: Experience creating guidelines, patterns, or frameworks that other teams adopted and built on.

  • Global Mindset: Comfort designing experiences that balance global consistency with local relevance across markets and cultures.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience leading a small team of very senior ICs.

  • Experience designing financial products or other high-trust consumer experiences.

OUR BENEFITS

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

Our hybrid work model brings us to the office 3x per week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

This role can be based in any of our US offices: Palo Alto, Miami, or McLean.

COMPENSATION

Palo Alto, CA: The total compensation range for this role in Palo Alto is roughly $450k to $725k USD, comprised of both base salary and equity (in the form of RSUs: 3-year vest, 1-year cliff). Final compensation is determined by level, experience, and location.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the Role

Every product Nu Colombia launches needs a clear accounting and regulatory treatment before the first customer uses it. The Accounting and Regulatory Specifications (ARS) team, part of Controllership, owns that treatment: it protects the accuracy of our financial statements and regulatory reports, and lets Product and Engineering launch with confidence. As a Controllership Analyst (ARS), you will own the accounting and regulatory specification of the products and changes assigned to you, from the first assessment until the monthly close and the regulatory reports work correctly.

You will work side by side with Product, Engineering and our peers in other geographies. We are also an AI-first team: we build and use our own ARS AI agent and other automations to assess new products, simulate scenarios and draft specifications and memos, and we want people who help us push that further


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Defining the accounting and regulatory treatment of new products and changes to existing ones before they launch: specifications, accounting scripts, chart of accounts mappings and technical memos.

  • Joining our daily triage of new product initiatives and deciding which ones need a full accounting and regulatory assessment.

  • Testing the accounting and regulatory impact of new products with engineering in staging, validating the first operations in production and following up until the issues found are solved.

  • Supporting the monthly close by answering the questions from the accounting team after a launch.

  • Changing the way the team works with AI: using and improving our ARS AI agent and automations (product assessments, scenario simulations, report lineage, documentation), sharing what works and helping the team adopt it.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics, business administration, engineering or related fields.

  • Experience in accounting, finance, financial control or audit.

  • Experience applying accounting standards (IFRS and/or local GAAP) to define how a financial product or transaction should be recorded.

  • Hands-on experience using AI assistants or agents to automate analysis, documentation or reviews, and enthusiasm for testing what works.

  • Experience explaining technical accounting topics in simple, business-friendly terms, in writing and in conversation, to Product and Engineering teams.

  • Experience handling several topics at once in a fast-moving environment and following up until they are solved.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English to work with teams in different geos. (Must)

  • Experience with regulatory reporting to the Superintendencia Financiera, Banco de la República or Fogafín, and with the Colombian chart of accounts. (Nice to have)

  • Experience with SAP or another ERP, SQL or Python to automate analysis.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Staff Product Designer (IC7), Credit Builder

Location: Miami (hybrid). We'll also consider candidates near other Nubank hubs, including São Paulo.

Team: Global Credit Card, Credit Builder

About the role

Millions of people across Latin America have never had a credit card. For many of them, Nubank is the first institution that gives them a real path to one. Credit Builder is where that path starts.

Our Credit Builder card is an entry-level credit product. Customers add money to unlock spending power, and we coach them step by step toward a full credit limit. The goal isn't to keep people on a starter product. It's to move them up and out of it, and most of our success stories do exactly that. The experience is built around gamification. A guided timeline walks customers through adding to their money box, increasing their limit, setting up autopay and building healthy habits. It has become one of the highest-NPS experiences at Nu and a model for gamification across the company.

Today Credit Builder runs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. Next year our scope roughly flips. We'll bring our under-18 credit product, our credit score product (NuScore) and Credit Builder into more countries, possibly including the US. We're also planning a significant revamp of the core experience.

We're hiring a Staff Product Designer to help set the craft bar for this work. You'll be one of the most senior designers in Global Credit Card, working on both the high-visibility revamp and the day-to-day product work that keeps a fast-moving, multi-country team shipping.

What you'll do

  • Lead design for Credit Builder and related underserved-credit products across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia and new markets, including the US.

  • Drive the upcoming revamp of the Credit Builder experience, raising the bar on visual craft, interaction design and motion.

  • Design global solutions that hold together as one system while adapting to local needs, such as regulatory requirements, cultural context and market-specific constraints.

  • Push gamification and financial-coaching patterns further, helping customers understand how credit works and how to grow it.

  • Mentor and level up the more junior designers on the team, through critiques and day-to-day collaboration.

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, business analysts and a dedicated researcher, plus the market design teams in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia and adjacent teams such as Growth, Core and Collections.

  • Get hands-on with the full range of work, from the most ambitious projects to quick everyday design tasks, and move fast across both.

What we're looking for

  • An exceptional craft bar: polished visual and interaction design, strong systems thinking, and comfort with motion.

  • Proven experience designing complex products, ideally in fintech, financial services or other regulated or multi-market settings.

  • Strong strategic judgment, and comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities and shifting scope.

  • Excellent stakeholder management across countries, time zones and functions, with the ability to align global and local partners.

  • A low-ego, hands-on mindset. On a lean team covering many products and markets, everyone pitches in, including senior folks.

  • Experience mentoring designers and raising the quality of a team's work.

  • A portfolio that shows both depth of craft and the thinking behind it.

Nice to have

  • Spanish and/or Portuguese.

  • Experience with gamification, behavior-change design or financial-education products.

  • Experience designing for underserved or first-time credit customers.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to work in person with market teams. Team leadership typically visits partners about twice a year.

Why Nubank

  • Real impact: you'll design the product that opens the door to credit for people who have often been shut out.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Engineering at Nu

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, that currently includes a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You can read more about it in our engineering blog and get some insights into how we work.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Lead one or more teams of 8~10 software engineers (ICs)

  • Foster a culture of teamwork, feedback and continuous improvement

  • Conduct effective 1:1s, team meetings and rituals

  • Manage individual contributors, enabling them to be high performers and support others

  • Deliver distributed systems at scale

  • Align stakeholders around team’s vision, goals, and metrics

  • Reason about software architecture design decisions

  • Look and implement improvements in the way we work and organize

 

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Experience leading Engineering teams, ideally with a background as a software engineer or software architect

  • Experience being accountable for people management, having exposure to performance assessment, hiring, supporting career growth, etc

  • Experience leading agile teams, being familiar with the most relevant ceremonies, metrics and processes

  • A good level of technical understanding, being able to take part in architecture discussions with Engineers and to translate complex, technical projects and concepts for non-engineers.

  • Advanced level of English - you'll be part of a global team

Location
Palo Alto, US

Work model
Hybrid

Office requirement

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

 

Our Benefits

• Opportunity of earning equity at Nu
• Medical Insurance
• Dental and Vision Insurance
• Life Insurance and AD&D
• Extended maternity and paternity leaves
• Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
• NuLanguage - Our language learning program
• NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
• 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account
• Work-from-home Allowance
• Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

As a SOX Specialist in Nubank's SOx Internal Controls team, you will own the ICFR cycle for a defined portfolio of processes, from walkthroughs to audit-ready testing. As a second line function, we challenge process and control owners so that management can sign its SOx 302/404 conclusions with confidence.

This role is built on strong accounting and financial statement skills. You should be able to define materiality and scope of accounts by reading the Group's financial statements, and apply GAAP (mainly IFRS) to design controls that prevent material misstatements on a timely basis. Your accounting and disclosure knowledge is what lets you hold deep discussions with Finance specialists and with the external auditors throughout the audit.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Owning the ICFR cycle for a defined process portfolio: Risk and Control Matrix (RCM), narratives, walkthroughs, TOD and TOE.

  • Linking the risks identified in the RCM directly to the financial statement line item (FSLI).

  • Applying Nu's internal methodology and tying Risk → Assertion → Objective → Control → Evidence.

  • Determining technologies in scope and deciding when to request SOC reports (ITGC).

  • Challenging process and control owners, and treating IPE/EUC in design and testing.

  • Executing TOE according to sampling and RoMM, and independently producing audit-ready workpapers.

  • Drafting deficiency texts that size impact, magnitude and probability on the financial statements, and tracking remediation with the first line.

  • Contributing to cross-functional discussions with IT, Finance, first line and external audit counterparts on your scope.

  • Using low-code automation and AI with a risk lens, never as a substitute for professional skepticism.

  • Leading a specific pack, process or workstream, sharing what you learn and supporting teammates.

  • Contributing to cross-functional discussions with IT, first line and external audit counterparts on your scope.

  • Deal with complex and increasingly ambiguous problems that involve several stakeholders, trade-offs between speed and rigor, and a busy calendar of changes and new geographies, with no predefined path to the solution.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Education: Degree in Accounting, Economics or Business Administration, around 6 years of experience in similar positions.

  • At least one of following experiences: Big 4 integrated audit; public-company Internal Audit with an annual SOX cycle; 2LoD Internal Controls / SOX office; controllership experience.

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to document workpapers and manage stakeholders around the world.

  • Independence on scoped projects: you close SOX deliverables with light review, not constant supervision.

  • Deep understanding of accounting principles, mainly IFRS (for example, IFRS 9, IFRS 18), and of financial statement disclosure.

  • Ability to read the Group's financial statements to define materiality and scope of accounts.

  • Ability to explain which assertion a control mitigates and how its failure becomes a misstatement.

  • Working knowledge of COSO 2013 and PCAOB standards, including AS 2201.

  • Knowledge of AI tools and light-coding programs (Databricks, Cursor, Gemini). Build no-code/low-code AI automations independently and weighs initiatives by ROI, effort and risk.

Work Setup

Location

Sao Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Every month, quarter and year, Nu Colombia has to deliver accurate accounting and regulatory reports to the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC), Banco de la República and Fogafín, and every new product has to reach those reports correctly from day one. The Regulatory Reporting team, part of Controllership, prepares, reviews and transmits those reports and solves the issues that come up along the way. As a Controllership Analyst (Regulatory Reporting), you will own a portfolio of regulatory reports end to end: from the data that feeds them to the final submission and any follow-up from the regulator.

You will work side by side with the Accounting, Product, Engineering and Data teams, and with our peers in other geographies. We are also an AI-first team: we are automating report controls and validations and we want people who help us push that further.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Preparing, reviewing and transmitting the Controllership regulatory reports to the SFC, Banco de la República and Fogafín, on time and with quality.

  • Reviewing the monthly close figures to detect issues that could affect the regulatory reports, and working with Accounting and Data to fix them at the source.

  • Investigating and solving data and reporting issues, including cases where the data does not arrive as expected, and answering regulator inquiries about the reports.

  • Assessing the regulatory reporting impact of new products and features, and testing and implementing them with Engineering before launch.

  • Implementing new and updated regulatory report formats, and supporting internal and external audits of regulatory reports.

  • Changing the way the team works with AI: using and improving automations and controls (such as our Validation Platform), sharing what works and helping the team adopt it.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics, business administration, engineering or related fields.

  • Experience in regulatory reporting in the financial sector, preparing and submitting or auditing reports to financial regulators.

  • Experience in accounting, finance, financial control or audit.

  • Understanding of accounting standards (IFRS and/or local GAAP) and of how transactions flow into the books and the reports.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English to work with teams in different geos. (Must)

  • Attention to detail and a control mindset: reconciling numbers, spotting inconsistencies and following up until the issue is solved.

  • Hands-on experience using AI assistants or agents to automate analysis, documentation or reviews, and enthusiasm for testing what works.

  • Experience explaining technical topics in simple, business-friendly terms, in writing and in conversation, to Accounting, Product and Engineering teams.

  • Experience handling several deadlines at once in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with reports to the Superintendencia Financiera, Banco de la República or Fogafín, and with the Colombian chart of accounts. (Nice to have)

  • Experience with SQL, Scala or Python to automate analysis.

 

Work Setup

Location

Bogota, Colombia

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the Role

You will lead the models and credit policy behind Nu’s new credit limit product in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. It is in its growth stage, with a pilot already live in Brazil. You will turn that pilot into a multi-country program and decide which models to build and how credit decisions affect long-term value and customers. You will join the Credit Card division, which drives most of Nu’s profit and growth, and work with high autonomy in a fast-paced global team.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Own the program end-to-end: design, launch, measurement, iteration and scale.

  • Deliver the models and credit policy to expand the Brazil pilot next year.

  • Adapt and scale the approach to other pilots

  • Define which models to build and how to model credit risk and returns, maximizing long-term financial value and customer impact.

  • Partner with design, product, engineering and marketing teams in each country.

  • Lead and develop the team

  • Contribute hands-on to modeling work when the team needs it

  • Experience taking a product or program from zero to launch.

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders.

  • Comfortable getting hands-on with the team

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

You will be responsible for high-complexity, high-impact brand design projects from end to end: from problem to system, from system to execution. This includes visual identity evolution, building and maintaining brand design systems, and assets that define how Nubank shows up in the world.

The scope spans multiple markets (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia) and sub-brands, requiring a balance between consistency and local adaptation without diluting the brand. You will work closely with brand strategy, creative, production, product, and external partners, and you will be called upon when the problem is ambiguous and the solution doesn't exist yet.


You’ll be Responsible for

Projects and Craft

  • Lead and execute brand design projects autonomously, defining the approach, direction, and quality bar

  • Be hands-on: explore, design, prototype, and finalize, without delegating what defines the quality of the work

  • Translate brand strategy into clear, distinctive, and consistent visual solutions

Systems

  • Envision, build, and evolve design systems that scale across markets, formats, and platforms

  • Define principles, guidelines, and components that empower others to create high-quality work autonomously

  • Ensure every delivery reinforces the system rather than creating exceptions that weaken it

Creativity and Conceptualization

  • Develop end-to-end concepts, from ideation to implementation, exploring high-impact ideas that can serve as launchpads for communication stunts

  • Work collaboratively in partnership with campaign development teams, both internal and external partners

Project Leadership

  • Drive complex projects involving cross-functional teams, orchestrating dependencies and decision-making

  • Influence senior stakeholders with design rationale, defending the work with clarity and openness to feedback

  • Collaborate with agencies and external partners, providing creative direction and raising the delivery bar

Team Reference

  • Serve as a benchmark for craft, attention to detail, and systems thinking, elevating the team through example, design crits, and targeted mentorship

  • Contribute to the future vision of brand design, including the integration of emerging technologies and AI into the creative process

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • A solid track record in design, with high-impact projects for major—preferably global—brands

  • A portfolio showcasing exceptional craft, systems thinking, and tangible business or brand impact

  • Proven experience leading complex projects without relying on hierarchical authority

  • Obsessive attention to detail paired with big-picture thinking

  • Creativity paired with rigor: bold ideas that hold up within a system

  • Advanced English proficiency to collaborate with global teams and stakeholders

  • Direct and confident communication, capable of presenting and pitching work to senior leadership

Nice to Have

  • Experience in branding or brand design at internationally scaled companies operating across multiple markets

  • Hands-on experience with brand design systems, beyond digital product/UI systems alone

  • A holistic perspective on design and art direction, spanning communication and advertising through to product design

  • A broad cultural repertoire that extends beyond traditional graphic design to incorporate references from other creative fields

  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to the creative workflow

Location

São Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2-3 days per week at the office.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Nu runs a twelve-year-old platform that has never stopped growing: thousands of microservices, low-latency payment rails, large-scale data platforms, machine learning in the critical path, and one mobile app carrying a dozen financial products across several regulated markets. We are expanding into new countries, new lines of business and new interfaces, including AI agents that act on customers’ behalf. Many of the systems we need for that don’t exist yet.

We’re hiring Senior Staff Software Engineers to be the technical reference for an area of the business. You’ll find the problems worth solving, design and ship the solutions, and raise the bar for the teams around you. If Staff is about making a team succeed, Senior Staff is about making an organization succeed. You’ll be matched to a specific team based on your depth and interests. Current areas include agentic and AI-native banking, payments and money movement, fraud, identity and risk, core banking, and platform and infrastructure.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  • Leading complex, ambiguous, strategic initiatives end to end, from setting the technical direction through to code running in production.

  • Spotting the problems worth solving in your area and delivering scalable solutions that change business results and strategy, not just roadmap items.

  • Shaping your area’s mid- to long-term strategy with product and business leaders, then turning it into a technical roadmap others can build on.

  • Making high-stakes architecture decisions where no clear precedent exists, and guiding teams through the trade-offs.

  • Setting standards beyond your own team, including design guidelines, quality bars and reusable components that other squads adopt.

  • Mentoring senior engineers, managers and peers across teams. You’ll also take part in hiring and lead or sponsor guilds.

  • Representing Nu in technical conversations with external partners, platforms and vendors.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

  • Extensive experience at Staff level or above (or equivalent) designing, building and running high-scale, mission-critical systems.

  • A track record of leading initiatives across organizational boundaries with little formal authority, and of seeing them land.

  • Evidence that you ship. You still write code and validate architecture in production.

  • Strong judgment in ambiguous situations, and a history of building systems from scratch as well as evolving large ones you inherited.

  • The ability to explain complex technical strategy clearly to engineers, product partners and senior leadership, and to build alignment around it.

  • A pragmatic, hands-on approach to AI. You use it to get more done, and you measure what it actually delivers.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, card networks, fraud and risk, or digital banking.

  • Experience building consumer-facing products at scale, with real product and UX sensibility.

  • Experience in regulated or otherwise unforgiving environments, where correctness matters more than speed.

  • Experience with LLMs, agent platforms or protocols such as MCP.

  • Portuguese or Spanish.

  • Clojure or functional programming experience. It’s our primary backend language, but it isn’t required: every engineer goes through an immersive Clojure onboarding.

LOCATIONS

Palo Alto, CA, USA · Miami, FL, USA · McLean, VA, USA · Toronto, ON, Canada · São Paulo, Brazil

WORK MODEL

This is a hybrid role, requiring attendance in the office 3 days per week. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

We are expanding into new countries, new lines of business and new interfaces, including AI agents that act on customers’ behalf. Many of the systems we need for that don’t exist yet. About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts and regions, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cost-efficient, without ever becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Senior Cloud Network Engineer on our Cloud Network platform engineering team, you will design, build and operate the cloud network that Nubank’s engineering teams rely on. You will treat the network as software: automated, tested and versioned. This is an IC5 role: you lead through technical depth, design quality and influence, not direct reports. You will be part of a global engineering organization and work with teammates across countries, so collaboration in English is part of everyday work.


You’ll be responsible for

  • Designing and evolving connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region and hybrid-cloud topologies, making sound architectural decisions in designs that span multiple teams.

  • Building and maintaining the network platform as code (Terraform or similar), with strong standards for testing, code review and reusable modules.

  • Owning the operational health of the platform in your scope: leading incident response, driving postmortems and following through on the tech debt they uncover.

  • Promoting safe change on the network: gradual rollouts, monitoring and fast rollback.

  • Defining observability for the platform, with monitoring and SLAs that surface issues before customers feel them.

  • Owning the network security posture of your scope, including segmentation and standards such as PCI DSS, with controls that hold up under audit.

  • Simplifying the topology over time through consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, balancing scalability, maintainability and cost.

  • Evaluating build vs. buy decisions with data on stability, scalability and cost.

  • Mentoring other engineers, taking part in hiring, and documenting decisions so knowledge travels across teams.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Production experience with public cloud networking, preferably AWS: Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns and network firewalls. Experience with Azure or GCP networking is also valued.

  • Experience connecting cloud and on-premises environments: hybrid connectivity, BGP and dynamic routing, IP address management, load balancers and firewalls, planning, deploying and troubleshooting at scale.

  • Coding and automation skills (Python, Go, Java, .NET), using infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), Git, CI/CD and containers to build and operate network infrastructure.

  • A background in network engineering, SRE, DevOps or software engineering. What matters is hands-on public cloud networking experience.

  • Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high-impact failures that cross team boundaries.

  • An analytical mindset focused on root causes and continuous improvement.

  • English proficiency to read, write and lead discussions across time zones.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Product Counsel, U.S. Products

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

As Product Counsel, U.S. Products, you will be the lead legal partner for the teams building and launching Nubank's U.S. consumer financial products. You will be one of the first lawyers in our new, standalone U.S. Legal function, reporting to the Head of U.S. Legal (or equivalent).

Nu is growing in the U.S., and every product we launch has to be compliant, simple for customers and fast to ship. Your work makes that possible: legal review sits inside the product lifecycle from the first idea, not at the end. Done well, our products earn the trust of customers and regulators alike.

You will own the first line of legal guidance for product squads, turning U.S. federal and state requirements into clear, practical direction they can act on. You will work closely with Compliance, Risk, Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Marketing, Operations and the global Legal team.

You'll be responsible for

Counseling product teams

  • Giving clear, fast and actionable legal guidance to product, engineering, data and business teams, from concept and design through launch, scaling and sunset.

  • Triaging the day-to-day legal questions that come from squads, and assessing legal and regulatory risk for new and existing U.S. products and features (deposit accounts, credit and lending, payments and cards, rewards and pricing), in line with Nubank's risk appetite.

  • Advising on the federal and state consumer financial laws behind our products, such as UDAAP, TILA/Reg Z, ECOA/Reg B, FCRA, EFTA/Reg E, TISA/Reg DD, and state licensing, lending and consumer protection laws.

  • Turning complex and changing requirements into simple guidance and design patterns that squads can use on their own, with no legal black boxes.

Customer-facing documents and marketing

  • Drafting, reviewing and approving account and credit agreements, terms and conditions, consents, notices and customer communications, and keeping them up to date.

  • Reviewing marketing, advertising, promotions and social media content against U.S. advertising, fair lending and UDAAP standards.

  • Partnering with Product Design and Operations on complaints, disputes and servicing, so customer outcomes are fair, transparent and well documented.

Partners, vendors and outside counsel

  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating agreements with U.S. banking, program, processing, technology and other partners, flagging risk and recommending proportionate protections.

  • Supporting third-party risk management with Procurement, Compliance, Security and Risk.

  • Working with outside counsel on specialized matters, and bringing consumer credit and fair lending knowledge in-house where it makes sense.

Regulatory readiness and leadership

  • Working with Compliance and Regulatory Affairs to prepare for examinations, audits and regulator inquiries, and supporting responses and remediation when needed.

  • Being a trusted counterpart for leaders in Product, Tech, Data, Security, Risk, Compliance and Operations.

We are looking for a person who has

  • A law degree (JD or equivalent) and an active license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, in the state where you practice.

  • Hands-on experience in financial services, fintech or regulatory law, in-house or at a leading law firm, with a significant part of that work advising on consumer-facing digital products.

  • Deep working knowledge of U.S. consumer financial services law as it applies to digital products, including UDAAP, TILA, ECOA, FCRA and EFTA, and familiarity with the bank regulatory framework and federal and state licensing.

  • A record of leading complex product matters end to end, such as launching or redesigning a consumer financial product, structuring and negotiating bank, program or fintech partnerships, or advising through regulatory examinations, inquiries or enforcement matters.

  • Experience working side by side with product, engineering and data teams, ideally as product counsel or in a compliance-by-design role.

  • An advisory approach: you design solutions and trade-offs that let compliance and innovation coexist, instead of acting as a blocker.

  • Strong commercial judgment: you prioritize risk, make clear recommendations and know when to escalate.

  • Comfort in a lean, global and fast-paced environment, with ambiguity and with balancing launch needs against long-term regulatory strategy.

  • Comfort using AI tools to draft, analyze and document, and with collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack and Google Workspace.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain complex legal concepts to non-lawyers in a clear, practical way.

Nice to have

  • Background in consumer credit and fair lending.

  • Experience working with or supporting interactions with U.S. regulators such as the CFPB, OCC, FDIC and state regulators.

  • Portuguese or Spanish.

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Chief of Staff to the CHRO

About the Role

The Chief of Staff to the CHRO is the operational and strategic backbone of the People & Culture organization. Working closely with the CHRO and the P&C Leadership Team (PLT), this person owns the team's reporting and operating rhythm and leads selected strategic initiatives. They bring independent judgment to consequential people and organizational decisions and serve as a trusted partner to P&C leaders and senior stakeholders across Nubank.

This is a broad role. It combines governance, strategic planning, and business analysis, and it is designed as an entry point to other roles in the organization. Candidates are evaluated both for the Chief of Staff role itself and for their potential to take on broader responsibilities over time.

This is an individual contributor role built on ownership and trust. We expect someone who anticipates needs, brings structure to ambiguous problems, and moves work forward with a high degree of autonomy. They build alignment across teams, challenge assumptions constructively, and know when to bring a trade-off or risk to the CHRO. The role requires sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive people and organizational matters.

You'll be responsible for

  • Own the P&C operating rhythm. Connect P&C strategic priorities to planning cycles, leadership forums, business reviews, and ensures a focused CHRO agenda, continuously reassessing what deserves her attention. Define what gets reported, to whom, and at what cadence.

  • Run the P&C management routines. Run the PLT forums and rituals with clear purposes, the right participants, and documented outcomes. Ensure agendas, pre-reads, and follow-ups are delivered on time. Continuously evolve how these forums work.

  • Shape priorities across the P&C portfolio. Maintain a clear view of major P&C initiatives across teams. Anticipate dependencies, identify overlaps and gaps, and bring leaders together to resolve trade-offs across capacity, risk, and business impact.

  • Bring independent judgment to CHRO and PLT decisions. Frame the decision, challenge assumptions, and identify the options and evidence leaders need to consider. Set standards for how data is validated and how recommendations are presented. Design the alignment process for complex decisions, surface disagreements early, and guide discussions toward resolution and clear ownership.

  • Drive follow-through on decisions and planning performance. Maintain a clear record of decisions, owners, and deadlines. Track P&C metrics against targets and budget, investigate material gaps, and recommend actions. Work with owners to resolve blockers and escalate risks early. Partner with Data, and People Analytics to keep P&C metrics reliable.

  • Build the Workforce Planning cycle. Help design the model, its inputs and governance, and run the planning in partnership with Finance, Talent Acquisition and the business units.

  • Leading short-cycle strategic projects. Pick up topics such as organizational design, AI initiatives, P&C operating model and ad-hoc leadership priorities. Get up to speed quickly, clarify the problem and deliver in weeks, not months;

  • Lead CHRO-sponsored initiatives. Drive a focused set of cross-functional initiatives where ownership is unclear. Define measurable outcomes, run the implementation, and track impact.

  • Partner with other areas of the organization. Build trust with other Chiefs of Staff and senior leaders, building trust and speaking their language. Work with Internal Communications to cascade P&C priorities and decisions.

We are looking for a person who has

Professional experience & education

  • Previous experience in management consulting, strategy, business operations, people analytics or an executive-adjacent role in a large, complex organization.

  • Business analyst capabilities, with strong structured problem-solving and diagnostic skills.

  • Experience operating alongside and influencing senior leaders.

  • Track record of running reporting, planning or governance cycles independently.

  • Knowledge of Workforce Planning (headcount modeling, demand and supply forecasting, scenario analysis, budget linkage) is desirable.

  • Familiarity with People Analytics and HR data (e.g. Visier or similar tools) is a plus.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to frame complex material for executive decision-making.

  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Slides (or equivalent); SQL or data visualization tools are an advantage.

  • Fluent English; Spanish or Portuguese is an advantage.

Competences & attributes

  • Exceptionally disciplined and rigorous: Operates with rigor in everything from analysis to meeting preparation, closes the loop on every commitment, and delivers on time.

  • Learning Agility: Learns fast, structures complex and ambiguous problems. Strong prioritization and autonomous execution across multiple concurrent workstreams;

  • Strong relationship builder: Builds trusting relationships quickly with senior leaders and handles demanding stakeholders with maturity.

  • High ownership and a high bar: Moves work forward without being pushed, and challenges the PLT respectfully when needed.

  • Discretion: Treats confidential information, especially on people, compensation and organizational topics, with absolute care.

  • Analytical mindset: Comfortable turning data into clear recommendations.

  • São Paulo, Brazil
